norm: It's rude to exclude coworkers in social gatherings.
situation: Steve was inviting everyone at the office to his birthday party, but Scott was sick that day.
intention: Steve wants to finish inviting people.
moral_action: Steve drives all the way to Scott's house to give him the invitation.
moral_consequence: Scott thanks Steve for the invitation and later enjoys the party.
immoral_action: Steve decides it's too much work to find Scott just to give him the last invitation.
immoral_consequence: Scott hears about the party and believes he's the only one who wasn't invited.

norm: Cheating on someone is deceptive and unfair.
situation: Tom is in a relation but is finding himself more and more attracted to other women.
intention: Tom wants to have sex with a gorgeous woman he recently met.
moral_action: Tom tells his girlfriend he is attracted to another woman.
moral_consequence: Toms girlfriend says she understands and tells him he is free to pursue her, they remain good friends and Tom ends up sleeping with the gorgeous woman.
immoral_action: Tom asks the gorgeous women if she wants to hook up with him.
immoral_consequence: She says yes, but finds out he is in a relationship and lets his partner know, she never meets him and his partner leaves him as well.

norm: Working hard is a good way to spend time.
situation: Tim has just learned that he has an extended weekend two extra days off.
intention: Tim wants to find something to do with the extra time.
moral_action: Tim spends the extended weekend working on a side project.
moral_consequence: Tim feels accomplished after spending his days off in a productive manner.
immoral_action: Tim decides to spend his days off playing video games.
immoral_consequence: Tim is unmotivated when he returns to work from being off so many days.

norm: It's bad to drug your dog.
situation: Jane's dog keeps on barking  and barking so Jane can't get to sleep at night.
intention: Jane wants to get to sleep.
moral_action: Jane trains the dog not to bark unless there's a problem.
moral_consequence: Jane's dog starts being quiet at night on it's own so Jane can sleep.
immoral_action: Jane gives the dog some medicine so that it falls asleep.
immoral_consequence: It gradually takes more and more medicine to work and eventually Jane gives the dog too much and it dies.

norm: It is discourteous to treat your significant other harshly.
situation: John and Jeff are married and John comes home from work to find Jeff hasn't made dinner.
intention: John wants to convey his anger at not having something to eat.
moral_action: John asks Jeff if he could please make sure dinner is ready in the future because he's exhausted and starving when he gets home from work.
moral_consequence: Jeff agrees that's it's only fair that since he stays home all day he should have something ready for John to eat when John gets home.
immoral_action: John smacks Jeff across the face for failing to perform his duties.
immoral_consequence: Jeff reports John to the police for domestic assault and John is arrested.

norm: You shouldn't feel responsible to feed your friends.
situation: Ben hardly has any food left until payday, but his friends, Julie and Jim, just showed up to play cards, and he wanted to eat some potato chips.
intention: Ben wants to have a snack.
moral_action: Ben takes out just enough chips for himself, and tells Julie and Jim, he's sorry, but doesn't have anything to offer them,.
moral_consequence: Ben is able to satiate his appetite and is able to save some for later.
immoral_action: Ben dumps the chips into a bowl and tells Julie and Jim to help themselves because he didn't want to feel like a bad host.
immoral_consequence: Ben's appetite isn't satisfied because he felt the need to share what little he had.

norm: It's rude to ghost someone online.
situation: Allister was having an online relationship with Betty, but has become bored with it.
intention: Allister wants to break it off with Betty.
moral_action: Allister tells Betty he wants to move on and wishes her well.
moral_consequence: Betty is upset, but gets over Allister, and she doesn't wish him any ill will.
immoral_action: Allister stops all contact with Betty and doesn't respond to any of her messages.
immoral_consequence: Betty becomes distraught thinking Allister is hurt or dead, and later resents him when she finds out he's fine.

norm: It's important to be open and honest with your partner.
situation: Charlie has a very painful stroke one evening when going to bed when his wife asks him what is wrong.
intention: Charlie wants to respond to his wife.
moral_action: Charlie describes his symptoms to his wife as well as he can, saying that it hurts terribly.
moral_consequence: Charlie's wife rushes Charlie to the ER where they successfully treat him.
immoral_action: Charlie says that he feels a little unwell and should be better by the morning.
immoral_consequence: Charlie goes to sleep and never wakes up due to the brain damage from the stroke.

norm: It is good to help someone in a bad relationship.
situation: Lana is friends with Jane who is knocking on her door saying she needs to stay the night after she was punched by her boyfriend.
intention: Lana wants to respond to Jane who is at the door.
moral_action: Lana lets Jane in and comforts her while keeping her safe.
moral_consequence: Jane will feel secure and cared for.
immoral_action: Lana tells Jane to come back tomorrow when Lana has time.
immoral_consequence: Jane will have nowhere to go and may be abused again.

norm: It's good to give money to needy causes.
situation: Maxwell wins some money on a game show.
intention: Maxwell wants to spend his money.
moral_action: Maxwell donates some of the money to charity.
moral_consequence: Maxwell receives a small thank you gift at Christmas for his donation.
immoral_action: Maxwell spends all of his money on buying himself a new car.
immoral_consequence: Maxwell can not afford the property tax on the car.

norm: It's good to break up fights between people.
situation: Ollie was at his friend's house when two of his friends got into a fight.
intention: Ollie wants the fight to end.
moral_action: Ollie jumps between the two boys and stops the fight right then and there.
moral_consequence: The boys end up apologizing to each other after the fight de-escalates.
immoral_action: Ollie waits until one boy knocks another boy unconscious to tell his friend's mother.
immoral_consequence: The boy ends up having to go to the hospital and was in a coma for two days.

norm: It's good to have a purpose in life.
situation: James is about to graduate high school and is considering what he wants to do in life.
intention: James wants to choose a direction in life.
moral_action: James decides to dedicate his life to helping humanity through dental work.
moral_consequence: James goes to medical school, becomes a dentist, and helps people with their tooth problems.
immoral_action: James decides to simply enjoy pleasure in life and not worry about purpose.
immoral_consequence: James becomes addicted to several forms of pleasure such as alcohol and video games and makes a mess of his life.

norm: It's wrong for people to physically assault each other.
situation: Tony and Tom are having an argument over who's favorite football team is better.
intention: Tony wants to make Tom agree that Tony's team is better.
moral_action: Tony provides Tom with a detailed statistical breakdown that proves Tony's team wins more often.
moral_consequence: Tom agrees to stop rooting for his old team and become a fan of Tony's team.
immoral_action: Tony twists Tom's arm until Tom agrees that Tony's team is superior.
immoral_consequence: Tom calls the police on Tony who is arrested for assault.

norm: You shouldn't hang around someone's house when they aren't home.
situation: Johnny drives over to Steves apartment but Steve is not home when Johnny arrives.
intention: Johnny wants to make sure than himself and Steve see each other that day.
moral_action: Johnny texts Steve saying that he is in the area and grabs lunch at a cafe while he waits for his reply.
moral_consequence: Steve texts Johnny back a few minutes later, says that he is back home and that Johnny can come by anytime.
immoral_action: Johnny notices that the door is unlocked, so he goes inside to wait until Steve comes back.
immoral_consequence: Steve thinks that someone has broken in when he gets back and calls the police to investigate.

norm: It's rude to make outrageous demands for your wedding.
situation: Jane is getting married and wants her whole wedding to have a red and white color scheme.
intention: Jane wants to make sure her bridesmaids match the color scheme.
moral_action: Jane picks a red bolt of fabric and lets each bridesmaid design a dress out of it.
moral_consequence: The bridesmaids love their dresses and everyone is cheerful on the day of the wedding.
immoral_action: Jane insists that all her bridesmaids wear wigs or dye their hair in the same shade of red.
immoral_consequence: Two bridesmaids drop out of the wedding and two more have major fights with Jane.

norm: It's rude to angrily raise your voice to strangers.
situation: Billy is on a bus when a passenger he doesn't know steps on his foot.
intention: Billy wants to let the passenger know that they are stepping on his foot.
moral_action: Billy informs the passenger that they are stepping on him and asks them to kindly remove their foot.
moral_consequence: The passenger apologizes but is glad the matter was addressed in a civil way.
immoral_action: Billy yells at the passenger in a harsh tone to get of his foot.
immoral_consequence: The passenger is embarrassed to have been addressed so harshly over an innocent mistake.

norm: You should punish students that steal your things.
situation: Stacy is an elementary teacher who has a student who went into her purse and stole $10.
intention: Stacy wants to avoid discouraging the student.
moral_action: Stacy talks with the student about the consequences of his actions, then punishes him.
moral_consequence: The student learns from the talk and refrains from stealing again.
immoral_action: Stacy talks to the student and decides not to punish him so that he will self-correct.
immoral_consequence: The student thinks that he can get away with stealing and develops a stealing habit.

norm: You shouldn't push your sibling overboard on a boat ride.
situation: Edric and his brother are having a boat race to the end of the lake.
intention: Edric wants to win.
moral_action: Edric takes a shorter route to the finish line.
moral_consequence: His brother learns more about the lake after Edric explains his win.
immoral_action: Edric bumps into his brother's boat on purpose.
immoral_consequence: His brother is knocked off the boat and almost drowns.

norm: It is wrong to betray your marriage vows.
situation: Dennis had been married to Elaine for twenty five years.
intention: Dennis wants to go on a date.

norm: It's bad to want to off yourself.
situation: Nicky is alone in his house and has been feeling depressed for a really long time.

immoral_consequence: Nicky's life ends when he commits suicide.

norm: You shouldn't smoke marijuana if it's illegal.
situation: Bob was in his house on Canusa Avenue and wanted to smoke pot.

moral_consequence: Nothing happened to Bob since he was not breaking the law.

norm: You should never be forced into a sexual act.
situation: Jane goes out on a date with John and feels pressured by John's constant offer of sex.

norm: It's bad to gamble away too much money.

norm: It is bad to cause a scene in public

norm: It's important to be honest with your friends

norm: It's bad to steal someone's phone from them.

norm: It's okay to be into things people consider nerdy.

norm: It's nosy to ask about other's medication.

norm: It's impolite to exclude people with mental disabilities.

norm: You shouldn't expect everyone to like avocados.

norm: It's wrong to not be there for your friends.

norm: Taking things without permission is wrong.

norm: It's wrong not to take your job seriously.

immoral_action: Will goes to a long lunch with his coworkers that takes over a couple hours, and he drinks several beers.

norm: It's good to accept a date.

norm: When people are upset it helps to do something

immoral_consequence: Wendy's coworker becomes increasingly upset regarding her situation and breaks down crying later that day.

norm: You shouldn't insult your siblings

norm: You shouldn't eat someone else's birthday cake all by yourself.

norm: It's good to swap with people.

immoral_action: Reba refuses to swap with Jack because she does not think his sandwich will be very good.
immoral_consequence: Jack's feelings are hurt, and he does not think Reba likes him.

norm: You shouldn't tell someone to kill themselves.

norm: It's good to always be prepared in case of emergencies

moral_consequence: A hurricane comes through but does not cause any serious problems for John.
immoral_action: John decides preparing for a hurricane is not worth his time and money.
immoral_consequence: John's home gets ruined by a hurricane.

norm: It's wrong for parents to break ties with their children.
situation: Suzy is having a fight with her daughter, who has been staying out late partying.
intention: Suzy wants her daughter to act morally.
moral_action: Suzy arranges an intervention for her daughter and tries to strengthen their relationship.

immoral_action: Suzy tells her daughter to leave, and then refuses to answer her calls after she's gone.
immoral_consequence: Suzy's daughter feels abandoned but ends up apologizing and changing her behavior.

norm: It's good to have dinner with friends.

norm: It's wrong to throw something at your sibling.

norm: It's rude to ghost people.

norm: You shouldn't leave your clothes behind.

norm: One should tip a server unless they provided poor service.

norm: It's rude to judge someone based on their footwear.

norm: You should respect your significant other's friendships.

norm: You should let people know when you cancel your plans.
situation: Jake decides last minute that he does not want to go out will Ted.
intention: Jake wants to stay home and watch Netflix instead.
moral_action: Jake calls Ted and tells him to come over instead.
moral_consequence: Jake and Ted hang out and watch Netflix together.
immoral_action: Jake doesn't tell Ted about the change of plans and sits at his house instead.
immoral_consequence: Ted is upset that Jake would blow him off like that.

norm: It's bad to miss half the class.
situation: Yvette is a biology major who has been invited to breakfast by her sorority sisters, but the timing interferes with her class schedule.
intention: Yvette wants to go out with her sorority sisters.
moral_action: Yvette grabs a coffee with her sisters but doesn't stay to eat.
moral_consequence: Yvette makes it to her biology class on time after a quick chat with her sisters.
immoral_action: Yvette goes out with her sorority sisters, but her biology class is halfway through by the time she arrives from breakfast.
immoral_consequence: Yvette misses important information and fails her next bio exam.

norm: It is good to be a responsible animal owner.
situation: Hope had always wanted a pet when she was growing up but her parents wouldn't allow it.
intention: Having moved into her first apartment Hope wants to get a pet.
moral_action: Hope buys a chameleon and is sure to follow all the care instructions the pet store gives her.
moral_consequence: Hope's pet is healthy and happy and provides her the companionship she wanted.
immoral_action: Hope buys a chameleon but is too busy to maintain it's specific living conditions and so it soon becomes ill.
immoral_consequence: Hope has to pay multiple vet bills for her pet and get chastised by the vet for her poor care.

norm: It's nice to spark joy in others.
situation: Josephine is a mother of four, and she is at home with her family.
intention: Josephine wants to keep her children busy.
moral_action: Josephine is able to conceal her plans for her children to do their top pastime together until the last moment and drops the news on them.
moral_consequence: Josephine's are surprised and elated by the news they get to do one of their favorite things and are filled with joy.
immoral_action: Josephine gives her kids a repetitive unneeded task to do, so they have something to occupy themselves with.
immoral_consequence: Josephine's children find themselves bored and miserable by being stuck doing the task.

norm: People should not leave work without notice.
situation: Mark is at his desk in the office when he receives an email that his wife had to be rushed to hospital.
intention: Mark wants to go to the hospital.
moral_action: Mark quickly sends an email to his boss saying he has to leave for an emergency and runs to his car.
moral_consequence: Mark's boss is understanding that Mark had to leave and writes back to Mark to not worry about it.
immoral_action: Mark gets up from his desk and without even locking his computer leaves and goes to his car.
immoral_consequence: Mark's boss becomes worried about Mark and the office starts to panic when they can't find him.

norm: It's rude to dress down friends in public.
situation: Rebecca is a new model about to walk down the runway with her friends.
intention: Rebecca wants to stand out.
moral_action: Rebecca walks with confidence down the runway striking unique poses as she walks.
moral_consequence: Rebecca's modeling life kicks off when one of her runway pictures goes viral.
immoral_action: Rebecca wears the best parts of all the outfits leaving her friends with similar runway looks.
immoral_consequence: Rebecca loses the trust of the more experienced models.

norm: Often getting sexually involved with a friend is foolish.
situation: Markus is having a fun night at the club.
intention: Markus wants to have sex.
moral_action: Markus picks a stranger and takes them home to have sex.
moral_consequence: Markus has an enjoyable sexual experience with no strings attached.
immoral_action: Markus sees a friend and takes him home and has sex with him.
immoral_consequence: Markus and his friend become distant after sharing an intimate time together.

norm: It's rude to hurt close family's feelings with bad behavior.
situation: John's favorite sports team just lost a game, and he sees his wife Mindy and kids in the kitchen eating.
intention: John wants to feel powerful.
moral_action: John goes to work out in his gym and then goes to a movie with his family.
moral_consequence: Mindy and his kids feel closer to John and love and respect him.
immoral_action: John tells Mindy and his kids that they eat like animals, and he can't stand them.
immoral_consequence: Mindy and his kids resent John and feel more distant from him.

norm: You should try to be patient with others.
situation: Jennifer is attending a meeting with coworkers, and they are proposing a plan for their business.
intention: Jennifer wants to create the best plan.
moral_action: Jennifer listens to all her coworkers' plans and then proposes her own plan.
moral_consequence: Her coworkers feel that Jennifer's plan is the best and the meeting agrees that they should use her plan.
immoral_action: Jennifer suggests her own plan by interrupting her coworkers' plans.
immoral_consequence: Her coworkers feel disrespected and ask Jennifer to leave the meeting.

norm: You should always support family members.
situation: Greg is at home relaxing when he gets a phone call from his mother Jan who asks him to borrow some money short term.
intention: Greg wants to respond to his mother's request.
moral_action: Greg tells his mother that he'll hop over to the bank and bring her some cash soon.
moral_consequence: Jan is delighted and relieved that she will get the money she needs and that she can count on Greg.
immoral_action: Greg tells his mother that if it's just short term she should go to a payday lender and deal with them.
immoral_consequence: Jan is upset that after she raised him and sacrificed for him growing up he's unwilling to help her when she needs it.

norm: You should always support an artist you enjoy.
situation: Anna loves a local artist named Felipe, who rents an art studio in town.
intention: Anna wants to see Felipe's art every day.
moral_action: Anna buys a large painting of Felipe's and hangs it on her wall at home.
moral_consequence: Felipe uses the proceeds from the sale to Anna to pay his rent and keeps his studio open.
immoral_action: Anna takes pictures of Felipe's art at his studio and looks at the pictures each day.
immoral_consequence: Felipe gets kicked out of his studio when he can't pay the month's rent after selling no paintings.

norm: You shouldn't do sketchy things around your partner.
situation: James frequently smokes meth, but his girlfriend has never tried drugs.
intention: James wants to feel accepted by his girlfriend.
moral_action: James tells his girlfriend about his meth use but only smokes when he's alone.
moral_consequence: James' girlfriend accepts his drug use as long as he maintains steady employment.
immoral_action: James smokes meth in front of his girlfriend on a regular basis.
immoral_consequence: James' girlfriend eventually asks to try the drug and becomes a regular user.

norm: It's wrong to trash a religion to someone.
situation: Mary heard her pastor say something that made her question her faith in church.
intention: Mary wants to criticize the pastors sermon to the pastor.
moral_action: Mary tell the pastor that she is questioning her faith because of the sermon but respects the pastor's choice in faith.
moral_consequence: The pastor thanks May for being civil, and they have a long chat about faith.
immoral_action: "Mary tells the pastor that the pastor's religion is, ""dumb"", and that she doesn't respect his sermon."
immoral_consequence: The pastor frowns at Mary and Mary feels guilty for saying this.

norm: It's rude to ask personal questions of strangers.
situation: Bob is working at a store and meets a talkative stranger.
intention: Bob wants to carry a conversation with the stranger.
moral_action: Bob asks the stranger about what he does for work.
moral_consequence: The stranger tells Bob about his job and continues the conversation.
immoral_action: Bob asks the stranger about his personal love life.
immoral_consequence: The stranger thinks that Bob is gay and gets creeped out.

norm: You should be careful when you're driving.
situation: Johnny's wife calls him to pick up his son from daycare.
intention: Johnny wants to listen to his new CD.
moral_action: Johnny waits to grab the new CD from the backseat until he's at a red light.
moral_consequence: Johnny arrives safely at his son's daycare and picks him up.
immoral_action: As Johnny was driving down the road, he reaches to the backseat to grab his new CD to listen to.
immoral_consequence: As he takes his eyes off the road, he collides with another car and is rendered unconscious.

norm: It's mean to dislike gay people.
situation: John and his wife Mindy are at home listening to the news when there's a story about gay rights.
intention: John wants to feel about himself.
moral_action: John says out loud how proud he is of them, and they are human like everyone else.
moral_consequence: John has a friendlier persona and other people in the house respect him more.
immoral_action: John laughs out loud and says gay people need to get therapy not rights.
immoral_consequence: John maintains his bias and ignorance and other people in the house respect him less.

norm: It is wrong to commit murder.
situation: Becky is in a terrible marriage with a husband who is physically and mentally abusive.
intention: Becky wants to get out of her marriage.
moral_action: Becky moves in with her sister and files for a divorce.
moral_consequence: Becky ends up getting most of the assets in the divorce settlement and is finally free.
immoral_action: Becky murders her husband one night while he is asleep.
immoral_consequence: Becky is arrested for the murder and gets twenty years in prison.

norm: You should always leave the bathroom clean and fresh.
situation: Lilly is living alone in her first apartment and is cleaning the house.
intention: Lilly wants to finish cleaning.
moral_action: Lilly makes sure to clean the bathroom good because she wants to do a complete job before finishing and taking a shower.
moral_consequence: Lilly has a presentable home, especially in the bathroom which matters most.
immoral_action: Lilly skips cleaning the bathroom because she finds it gross and it also means she is done cleaning faster.
immoral_consequence: Lilly's bathroom becomes more and more dirty to the point it could be a hazard to her health.

norm: It's rude to not apologize when you've done something wrong.
situation: James was running to catch his bus when he ran into someone on the sidewalk.
intention: James wants to catch his bus before it leaves.
moral_action: "James pauses for one second to say, ""Sorry, sorry,"" before running after the bus."
moral_consequence: "The pedestrian yells back, ""Run, Forrest, run!"" as James climbs on the bus."
immoral_action: "James keeps running and yells over his shoulder, ""Watch where you're going, moron!""."
immoral_consequence: "The pedestrian yells back, ""You're the moron, you blind jackass!"" as James gets on the bus."

norm: You should not use urinals for things other than peeing.
situation: Rick is waiting in line for a restroom stall to open up at a busy sports venue.
intention: Rick needs to poop.
moral_action: Rick sees a restroom door open and uses the stall to defecate.
moral_consequence: Rick is relieved and goes back to his seat to enjoy the game.
immoral_action: Rick sees a urinal nearby the stall doors and decides to use it to defecate.
immoral_consequence: The men in the restroom get angry at Rick and push him out of the venue while swearing.

norm: It's good to show remorse for your actions
situation: Claire is walking through the mall when she realizes that she has unintentionally let the door slam in a lady's face.
intention: Claire wants to quickly get to her intended store.
moral_action: Claire reaches back, opens the door, and apologizes to the lady before heading on her way.
moral_consequence: The lady accepts Claire's apology.
immoral_action: Claire looks away from the lady and continues to her destination.
immoral_consequence: The lady thinks that Claire is a rude person.

norm: It is important to keep contact with other people.
situation: Robert has been very focused on his career and realizes he hasn't called his grandmother in a while.
intention: Robert wants to plan a time to talk to his grandmother.
moral_action: Robert plans to make some time to call his grandmother over the weekend when he's less busy.
moral_consequence: Robert is able to reconnect with his grandmother, and they start to talk more regularly after that.
immoral_action: Robert decides to focus on trying to get a promotion at work first and that he will call his grandmother after that.
immoral_consequence: Robert doesn't call his grandmother for a couple more years, and by then she has developed Alzheimer's and doesn't fully remember him.

norm: You shouldn't sexually harass people.
situation: Matt thinks Brooke is attractive and wants to hook up with her.
intention: Matt wants to ask Brooke out.
moral_action: Matt asks Brooke if she would like to go dancing with him.
moral_consequence: Brooke agrees to go dancing later in the evening with Matt.
immoral_action: Matt touches Brooke on the butt while he asks her out.
immoral_consequence: Brooke slaps Matt in the face and runs away from him.

norm: It's rude to rebuff somebody after getting a gift
situation: It's almost Sandra's birthday and Sandra has asked her parents for an expensive black phone, but receives a white one instead.
intention: Sandra wants to get a different phone.
moral_action: Sandra thanks her parents for the phone, then finds someone online who wants to trade phones.
moral_consequence: Sandra and the other person get the phone that they really wanted and her parents aren't disturbed.
immoral_action: Sandra starts crying once she sees the gift and tells her parents that they don't love her, then demands the other phone.
immoral_consequence: Sandra's parents get offended at her lack of gratefulness and take the phone away.

norm: It's wrong to keep things that are not your's.
situation: Toby had a study session with Neal and Neal left his only jacket at Toby's place.
intention: Toby wants to decide what to do with the jacket.
moral_action: Toby decides to give the jacket back to Neal.
moral_consequence: Neal will have his jacket and not have to get a new one.
immoral_action: Toby decides to keep the jacket and not give it back to Neal.
immoral_consequence: Neal will have to buy a new jacket.

norm: It's rude to speak negatively of something someone likes.
situation: Sal is chatting with some friends about movies when his friend, Jason, mentions that he loved the last Star Wars.
intention: Sal wants to be perceived as a Star Wars expert by his friends.
moral_action: Sal compares different Star War movies in detail, but stays diplomatic about the weaknesses of the last one.
moral_consequence: James enjoys listening to Sal's opinion without being made to feel bad about what he likes.
immoral_action: Sal starts panning the last Star Wars movies, detailing all its flaws and telling James why it's dumb to like it.
immoral_consequence: James is hurt and feels humiliated by Sal's very negative comments about his favorite movie.

norm: You should train your dog not to bark.
situation: Sally has a noisy little dog even though she lives in an apartment complex that doesn't allow pets.
intention: Sally wants to train her dog.
moral_action: Sally trains her dog not to make any noise while it's inside her apartment.
moral_consequence: Sally buys her dog its own bed and makes the spare bedroom the dog's room.
immoral_action: Sally trains her dog to stand and walk on its hind legs.
immoral_consequence: Sally is evicted from her apartment when the landlord hears her dog barking one night.

norm: It's not wise to spend one's retirement money on vacations.
situation: George is an older man who is near retirement age but doesn't have quite enough money saved to live the lifestyle he wants.
intention: George wants to have a relaxing week off of work.
moral_action: George decides to take a road trip to visit his children's families.
moral_consequence: George saves money and is able to spend time with his grandchildren.
immoral_action: George decides to take a cruise to the Bahamas.
immoral_consequence: George has to work a couple years longer in order to have enough money to retire.

norm: It's not okay to not be concerned about children's education.
situation: Dave's child Max comes home after school and tells Dave his report card is ready.
intention: Dave wants to make a comment about the repor card.
moral_action: Dave tells Max to bring the report card to him right away, so he can look at it.
moral_consequence: Max is happy that his father is taking an immediate interest in how well he did this year.
immoral_action: Dave tells Max to go show the report card to his mother as he doesn't have time to look at it.
immoral_consequence: Max is sad that his father doesn't care whether he did good or bad in school.

norm: It's inappropriate to pick a fight in public.
situation: Vince is at a bar when he hears a terrible singer on the nearby stage.
intention: Vince wants to let the singer know that he dislikes his music.
moral_action: Vince leaves a note on the singer's personal belongings telling him that he needs to improve his performance.
moral_consequence: The singer resolves to practice more and improves.
immoral_action: Vince heckles the singer and calls him a girly wussy man that can't sing.
immoral_consequence: The singer's fans gang up on Vince and drag him outside.

norm: It's wrong to cut contact with family members.
situation: Brad is having a big dinner with his family during Christmas vacation and is offended by something his sister Teresa says.
intention: Brad wants to let Teresa know he is displeased with her.
moral_action: Brad tells Teresa that what she said offended him and it was not appropriate.
moral_consequence: Teresa apologizes for what she said and continues to enjoy a positive relationship with her brother.
immoral_action: Brad cuts off all contact with Teresa and refuses to return her calls and messages.
immoral_consequence: Teresa is sad and confused and misses having contact with her brother.

norm: You should let your parents sleep.
situation: Dave's parents are asleep upstairs and Dave is in the living room and just read a funny joke online.
intention: Dave wants to share the funny joke with someone.
moral_action: Dave logs onto a web forum and posts the joke for other users to read and comment on.
moral_consequence: Both Dave's parents continue to soundly sleep through the night and wake up rested.
immoral_action: Dave runs upstairs and bursts into his parents room, waking them up to tell them the joke.
immoral_consequence: Both Dave's parents are infuriated he has woken them up for something so trivial.

norm: You should share your things with your family.
situation: Katie's brush broke, and she needs to brush her hair but Kyle doesn't like her to use his brush.
intention: Katie wants to brush out her hair.
moral_action: Katie asks Kyle to borrow his brush, and he allows her to use it.
moral_consequence: Katie and Kyle continue to solidify their relationship built of mutual trust and respect.
immoral_action: Katie secretly uses Kyle's brush to brush her hair without asking Kyle's permission.
immoral_consequence: Kyle catches Katie and becomes irritated with her.

norm: It's rude to compare someone to a witch.
situation: Mia is a personal stylist meeting a new client, who has a long nose and very dark hair.
intention: Mia wants to say something about her new client's appearance.
moral_action: Mia tells her new client that her dark hair and face make her look very distinguished.
moral_consequence: Mia's new client is flattered and recommends to some of her friends to use Mia as a stylist.
immoral_action: Mia tells her new client that her long nose and dark hair mean she wouldn't have to wear a costume to look like a witch on Hallowe'en.
immoral_consequence: Mia's new client is insulted and fires Mia as her stylist.

norm: You should listen when your boss reprimands you.
situation: Rob who is always late for work, is at his desk when his manager, Giancarlo tells him to stop being late every day.
intention: Rob wants to respond to Giancarlo.
moral_action: Rob tells Giancarlo that he's truly sorry and that he'll get his act together and come on time.
moral_consequence: Giancarlo is happy to see Rob taking feedback to heart and working on improving his punctuality.
immoral_action: Rob tells Giancarlo that he doesn't care what he thinks because he's been doing it forever and it wasn't a problem before.
immoral_consequence: Giancarlo is livid that Rob is insubordinate and not accepting the most basic of feedback.

norm: Using profanity in many settings is strongly discouraged.
situation: Jack is waiting the line of cars to pick children up from their school.
intention: Jack wants to pick up his kid and leave quickly.
moral_action: When Jack is cut off  in the waiting line, he goes to the driver and explains they need to follow the rules and get in the back of the line.
moral_consequence: Jack resolves the situation with the person who cut line amicably.
immoral_action: When another car cuts line in front of Jack, he gets out and curses the driver out.
immoral_consequence: Jack is scolded by the school staff for using bad language in front of kids.

norm: You should get help for your depressed tweens.
situation: Janet's son Brad who is a majorly depressed twelve year old approaches her in the kitchen and tells her he's feeling really low lately.
intention: Janet wants to respond to Brad's statement.
moral_action: Janet tells Brad that this seems serious and that she will set up an appointment with a child psychologist.
moral_consequence: Brad finds the therapy of a great benefit, and he starts to see the light at the end of the depression tunnel.
immoral_action: Janet tells Brad that we all feel low sometimes but that he'll cheer up soon and everything will be OK.
immoral_consequence: Brad of course, doesn't get well soon as he's majorly depressed and begins contemplating dark ideas.

norm: You shouldn't tell on people.
situation: Holly is at her desk in the office when she notices her coworker Jason sneak into his desk late just before the manager comes in.
intention: Holly wants to say something to the manager.
moral_action: Holly  greets the manager and wishes him a good morning with a big smile.
moral_consequence: Jason is relieved that the manager doesn't seem to know he was late and that no one said anything.
immoral_action: Holly tells the manager that she just saw Jason walking in late right before the manager arrived.
immoral_consequence: Jason is furious that he's been thrown under the bus and is angry at Holly for not minding her own business.

norm: It's wrong to break the laws when you're driving
situation: Greg was driving on the highway in a busy part of town when he saw a red light at the next intersection.
intention: Greg wants to get to work.
moral_action: Greg waits at the red light and calls his boss to tell him that he is running late.
moral_consequence: Greg's boss tells him to take his time and Greg arrives to work safely.
immoral_action: Greg drives his car as fast as he can under the red light.
immoral_consequence: Greg's car is hit by an oncoming vehicle, and he needs to go to the hospital.

norm: It is wrong to be insensitive to other cultures.
situation: Lisa is attending a friends church with her.
intention: Lisa wants to be apart of their prayer.
moral_action: Lisa follows the churches way of prayer, asking for help and guidance to make sure she is doing it the way their culture does it.
moral_consequence: The people of the church are delighted to help teach Lisa their way of prayer in their culture.
immoral_action: Lisa doesn't understand their pray method of this culture and tells them they are doing it wrong.
immoral_consequence: The people at church are taken aback by the insult from Lisa.

norm: It's bad to fake having a medical condition.
situation: Arthur's son had a wheel chair, but he was at the doctor and had left his spare chair at home.
intention: Arthur wants to pick his son up form the doctor.
moral_action: Arthur parks in the back and walks his way up to the front.
moral_consequence: Arthur has no issues picking up his son from the doctor's.
immoral_action: Arthur sits in his son's chair, so he can park up front when picking his son up.
immoral_consequence: Arthur gets stuck in the chair since it's too far small for him.

norm: It's rude to make fun of someone's weight.
situation: Alexis is hosting a cookout when she notices her friend Chrissy eating something that breaks the rules of the diet she's been on.
intention: Alexis wants to talk to Chrissy about her diet.
moral_action: Alexis asks Chrissy if she can make her something that would adhere to her diet.
moral_consequence: Chrissy tells Alexis that that won't be necessary because she is allowing herself one day off track.
immoral_action: Alexis tells Chrissy that she wouldn't be so fat if she was able to stick to a diet.
immoral_consequence: Chrissy starts to tear up and leaves the cookout.

norm: You should not yell at your children.
situation: Mary's daughter was doing the dishes when she dropped one on the floor and broke it.
intention: Mary wants her daughter to be more careful.
moral_action: Mary talks to her daughter and tells her that broken glass can be dangerous.
moral_consequence: Mary's daughter continues to do the dishes, but never breaks a plate again.
immoral_action: Mary starts to yell at her daughter telling her that the dishes were expensive.
immoral_consequence: Mary's daughter starts to cry and doesn't want to help with the chores anymore.

norm: It's wrong to be intimate with family.
situation: Max has a birthday today and his sister just gave him a gift that Max loves.
intention: Max wants to hug his sister for the present.
moral_action: Max hugs his sister lightly and for not too long after receiving his gift.
moral_consequence: Max and his sister open more presents and have a pleasant time together.
immoral_action: Max hugs his sister very tightly and intimately after he receives his gift.
immoral_consequence: Max's sister feels Max is overstepping boundaries and Max tells his sister he is sorry.

norm: It's wrong to comment on the relationships of others.
situation: Bob is out with his friends who are dating, Tyler and Janice, and they are in a small spat.
intention: Bob feels awkward and wants to feel better.
moral_action: Bob changes the subject to try to improve things.
moral_consequence: The conversation is steered and the night improves.
immoral_action: Bob says something negative about the arguement.
immoral_consequence: Tyler and Janice get mad at Bob and tell him to stop butting in.

norm: It's good to always wear your wedding ring.
situation: Every day Daisy would take off her wedding ring to do the dishes, her husband found out and got upset.
intention: Daisy wants her husband to stop being upset.
moral_action: Daisy decides to keep wearing it so her husband won't complain.
moral_consequence: The dishwater wears out the ring over time and Daisy gets her husband to get her a much nicer new ring.
immoral_action: Daisy started making sure to only put the ring where her husband can't find it.
immoral_consequence: Daisy eventually put it somewhere where SHE couldn't find it either.

norm: You shouldn't snoop around your partner's things.
situation: Mary and John are out on a date but Mary's phone keeps vibrating.
intention: John wants to know who is calling Mary.
moral_action: John tells Mary it is ok if she needs to take the call as it won't be a big interruption on their date.
moral_consequence: Mary is grateful for John's understanding and explains who has been trying to contact her.
immoral_action: When Mary goes to the restroom John goes through her phone to see who is calling her.
immoral_consequence: Mary is livid when she catches John invading her privacy and cuts the date short.

norm: You should tell your employer when someone is unreliable.
situation: Josh's coworker Tony takes breaks that are way longer than they're supposed to be.
intention: Josh wants to tell someone about this.
moral_action: Josh decides to tell his boss that Tony is taking too long on break.
moral_consequence: Tony is disciplined and Josh no longer has to do more than his fair share.
immoral_action: Josh decides to tell his wife about it when he gets home from work.
immoral_consequence: Tony continues to take long breaks, increasing the workload on Josh.

norm: It's nice to give handouts.
situation: A beggar asks Robert for change as he is walking to work.
intention: Robert wants to respond to the man's request.
moral_action: Robert gives the man a couple dollars from his wallet.
moral_consequence: The man is able to eat dinner that night.
immoral_action: Robert ignores the man and keeps walking.
immoral_consequence: The man cannot afford to eat dinner that evening.

norm: It's wrong to want to rehome your pets.
situation: Lynn has acquired a lot of larger furniture which makes her small apartment feel cramped, and she is has a pet cat.
intention: Lynn wants to move to a new apartment.
moral_action: Lynn finds a bigger apartment which has a policy that allows pets on the premises.
moral_consequence: The cat adjusts to the new place and lives a more enjoyable life living with Lynn.
immoral_action: Lynn finds a nice apartment which doesn't allow pets, so she lets someone adopt the cat.
immoral_consequence: The cat struggles to adjust and misses the human she has a bond with.

norm: It's expected that humans take care of the planet.
situation: Lance lives in the country and has several bags full of recyclable trash in his house.
intention: Lance wants to dispose of the trash.
moral_action: Lance takes the trash to recycling center in the nearest large city.
moral_consequence: The trash is remade into useful products and decreases people's consumption of non-renewable resources.
immoral_action: Lance goes out into the woods and dumps the trash in a hole that he finds.
immoral_consequence: The trash sits in the woods and poisons the creatures who come near it to eat.

norm: It is unacceptable to make fun of other people.
situation: Marge is at work when she see's a coworker she likes trip and fall.
intention: Marge wants to use this opportunity to communicate with her coworker.
moral_action: Marge rushes over to her coworker and offers to help them.
moral_consequence: Marge and her coworker start talking and end up becoming close friends.
immoral_action: Marge points and laughs and calls her coworker a klutz.
immoral_consequence: Marge's coworker tells their boss, and she gets written up for the incident.

norm: It's good to follow all traffic signs.
situation: "John and Mark are in the car and John is driving as they approach main street which shows a ""no left turn"" sign from the current road they're on."
intention: John wants to drive south down main street.
moral_action: John continues straight down the road he's on and drives around the block before accessing main street from a different road.
moral_consequence: Mark is happy to take a scenic route and remarks how the houses look nice on the other streets.
immoral_action: John sees a gap in traffic and takes the opportunity to make the left turn anyway onto main street.
