immoral_action: Jessica tells Kelly she should get a dress with sleeves because her arm fat jiggles.
immoral_consequence: Kelly gets upset with Jessica, cries, and leaves Jessica at the mall alone.

norm: It's wrong to lose your soul mate.
situation: Dave and his wife Linda are sitting on the couch when Linda asks Dave to clean up after himself more.
intention: Dave wants to respond to Linda's request.
moral_action: Dave realizes that his wife is precious and that he needs to do better and tells her that he'll clean up right away.
moral_consequence: Dave is rewarded by Linda's loyalty, love and companionship for the rest of his life.
immoral_action: Dave tells Linda that he doesn't care about that and if she doesn't like it she can leave the relationship.
immoral_consequence: Dave later realizes that Linda was the one and spends the rest of his life pining after her.

norm: It's good to keep one's house looking pretty.
situation: Ashley made friends with a new group of people, but her house has trash all over the place.
intention: Ashley wants to invite her new friends over for a party.
moral_action: Ashley gets rid of all the trash and makes her house smell nice before inviting her friends over.
moral_consequence: Ashley's friends have a great time and decide to make her house one of their new hang out spots.
immoral_action: Ashley hides all the trash in the closet and invites her friends over.
immoral_consequence: Ashley's friends smell the trash and leave, deciding they shouldn't come over anymore.

norm: It's irresponsible to get kicked out of school
situation: Biff is assigned homework that he doesn't know how to complete.
intention: Biff wants the homework done.
moral_action: Biff decides to stidy hard until he knows how to do the homework.
moral_consequence: Biff gets an A and is proud of himself for his work.
immoral_action: Biff beats up George until he does the homework for him.
immoral_consequence: Biff gets kicked out of school for plagiarism and not doing his own homework.

norm: It's rude to disturb people in a public setting.
situation: Carol is eating at a restaurant when she notices her district's political representative whose policies she disagrees with sitting nearby, so she walks over to his table.
intention: Caroline wants to express her displeasure at the representative.
moral_action: Caroline asks for the representative's contact info and then later that evening sends him an email stating her problems with his policies.
moral_consequence: Caroline feels strong and accomplished, like perhaps she made a difference.
immoral_action: Caroline  raises her voice at him and begins asking him questions about his policies and motives.
immoral_consequence: Caroline is asked to leave the restaurant by the management who calls the police.

norm: It's kind to wish a mother well on Mother's Day.
situation: Isabelle lives a few states away from her mom and mother's day is approaching.
intention: Isabelle wants to avoid traveling to her mother's home on mother's day.
moral_action: Isabelle sets up a video chat, so she can virtually wish her mom a happy mother's day.
moral_consequence: Isabelle's mom tells her that seeing her face is enough to make her day.
immoral_action: Mother's day arrives and Isabelle stays home without seeing or talking to her mom.
immoral_consequence: Isabelle's mom waits all day to hear from her but gets nothing.

norm: Significant others are expected to be faithful to each other.
situation: Sara and her husband are having a good time drinking at cocktail party with a group of their friends.
intention: Sara wants to have sex.
moral_action: Sara suggests to her husband that they should go home because she is feeling randy.
moral_consequence: Sara and her husband enjoy a fun romp in the sack with each other.
immoral_action: Sara goes to the bedroom with the host of the party and has intimate relations.
immoral_consequence: Sara is divorced by her husband when he finds out that she has cheated on him with another man.

norm: You shouldn't be with someone who abuses your child.
situation: Matt has been dating Clarissa for a few months when his daughter tells him Clarissa smacks her in the head when he's not around.
intention: Matt wants to respond to his child's accusation.
moral_action: Matt breaks up with Clarissa and apologizes to his daughter.
moral_consequence: Matt's daughter feels safe confiding in her dad and is no longer being hurt.
immoral_action: Matt tells his daughter that she's being too sensitive and continues dating Clarissa.
immoral_consequence: Matt's daughter feels unloved and loses trust in Matt.

norm: Letting people know that you never liked them is mean.
situation: A person Kevin was never fond of, Paul, shows up at his door with a bottle of liquor and a movie, and says they are going to party.
intention: Kevin has to decide what to say to Paul.
moral_action: The two talk for a while and decide to watch the movie together.
moral_consequence: They both have a nice night, and they appreciate one another's company.
immoral_action: Kevin tells Paul that he never really enjoyed his company, and he tells him to leave.
immoral_consequence: Paul feels embarrassed and hurt and Kevin feels guilty about being so harsh.

norm: It is rude to refuse to help someone in need.
situation: John and Paul go to the grocery store to shop, but Paul forgot to bring his wallet.
intention: John wants to buy groceries.
moral_action: John buys his groceries in addition to the ones that Paul needs.
moral_consequence: Paul thanks John for helping him get food from the store.
immoral_action: John only buys all of the items that he planned to get.
immoral_consequence: Paul can't get any food for himself from the store.

norm: It's wrong to act on homicidal thoughts.
situation: Alex's girlfriend broke up with him and started a new relationship with another man Victor.
intention: Alex wants to react to the breakup.
moral_action: Alex accepts the breakup and extend his social circle in order to meet new people.
moral_consequence: Alex becomes happier and makes a lot of new friends.
immoral_action: Alex feels that Victor has caused the breakup, and he wants to end Victor's life so that his girlfriend will come back.
immoral_consequence: Alex has wild thoughts and becomes unforgiving and isolated.

norm: It's unacceptable to lie.
situation: Jamie's friend was shot at a party so cops are questioning people who were at the party, and Jamie knows who did it.
intention: Jamie doesn't want to look like a snitch in front of his friends.
moral_action: Jamie makes the cops give him witness protection in order to tell them what they want to hear.
moral_consequence: The man who shot Jamie's friend will not be able to harm anyone else in the future.
immoral_action: Jamie tells the cops that he didn't see anything and doesn't know what happened.
immoral_consequence: The person who shot Jamie's friend gets to run free and other lives are at risk.

norm: You shouldn't demand sex.
situation: Rachel and Becky are on a date together and are snuggling in bed.
intention: Rachel wants to have sex with Becky.
moral_action: Rachel asks Becky about the type of things she likes romantically and physically and the two become intimate under consensual terms.
moral_consequence: Rachel gets texts from Becky about how much she enjoyed their night together and the two promise to see each other again soon.
immoral_action: Rachel tells Becky that because she paid for the meal, Becky has to make it up to her with sex.
immoral_consequence: Becky says she feels coerced and leaves, blasting Rachel on social media for predatory behavior.

norm: You shouldn't eat dried toothpaste or you'll get sick.
situation: Kent was examining the bathroom sink, and he saw dried toothpaste.
intention: Kent wants to decide what to do with the toothpaste.
moral_action: Kent washes the countertop near the sink off, including the dried toothpaste.
moral_consequence: Kent's bathroom now looked fresh and clean after Kent cleaned it.
immoral_action: Kent tries to eat the toothpaste because he likes the flavor of it.
immoral_consequence: Kent feels ill and has to lie down in his room for a few hours.

norm: It is wrong to steal food from a restaurant.
situation: Brian is hungry and goes to a restaurant to eat.
intention: Brian wants a discount on his food.
moral_action: Brian bargains with the manager for a discount on the food.
moral_consequence: The manager agrees to knock 10% off of the price.
immoral_action: Brian eats his food and quickly runs out of the restaurant to avoid paying.
immoral_consequence: The police use video footage to identify Brian and arrest him.

norm: Saying vulgar things is offensive.
situation: Brad works in a restaurant as a server.
intention: Brad wants to get plenty of tips.
moral_action: Brad apologizes and cleans up after spilling an order.
moral_consequence: Brad gets tipped well for being diligent on the job in front of patrons.
immoral_action: Brad swears loudly when spilling an order in front of some patrons.
immoral_consequence: Brad doesn't get a tip because he offended the patrons who had brought their small kids.

norm: It's not okay to waste electric around the house.
situation: Chad is hanging out at home on a hot summer day and it is beginning to get warm inside.
intention: Chad wants to cool down.
moral_action: Chad goes for a swim at the local pool.
moral_consequence: Chad cools down in the water and has a great time swimming.
immoral_action: Chad leaves his air conditioning running at full capacity all day long.
immoral_consequence: Chad wastes lots of energy and his monthly electric bill gets very expensive.

norm: It's not right to hit a partner.
situation: James and his girlfriend have been fighting about money a lot recently, and James just found out she spent $150 eating at restaurants this week.
intention: James wants to convince his girlfriend to spend less money.
moral_action: James asks his girlfriend to create a separate bank account, so they can each manage their own spending money.
moral_consequence: James and his girlfriend fight much less once they disentangle their finances.
immoral_action: James punches his girlfriend and says he'll beat her every time she goes to a restaurant.
immoral_consequence: James' girlfriend presses assault charges, and he is rapidly imprisoned.

norm: It's generally frowned upon to have relationships at work
situation: Kyle is sitting in his office at work when his coworker Kyra comes by to ask him if he'd like to go out on a date.
intention: Kyle wants to respond to Kyra's date proposal.
moral_action: Kyle tells Kyra that he's flattered, but he doesn't think that's such a good idea.
moral_consequence: Kyle's decision ends up being good for him as he avoids potential work conflicts down the line.
immoral_action: Kyle tells Kyra that he would indeed love to go out with her, and he'll meet her after work.
immoral_consequence: Kyle is later forced to break up with Kyra and now he has an uncomfortable situation at work.

norm: It crass to talk about sex in public.
situation: Paul is at a McDonald's with his friend Daryl the day after going on a date, and they're sitting near a child named Trevor eating a Happy Meal.
intention: Paul wants to tell Daryl about the sex he had with his date last night.
moral_action: Paul waits until he and Daryl are driving home to tell him about the adventurous coitus he and his date had the previous night.
moral_consequence: Trevor goes to school the next day and tells his friends about the toy he got in his Happy Meal at McDonald's.
immoral_action: Paul describes in a high level of detail the adventurous sexual intercourse he engaged in with his date the previous night.
immoral_consequence: Trevor goes to school the next day and gets in trouble when he's heard by his teacher retelling Paul's sex story.

norm: It's rude to disappear from someone's life without explanation.
situation: Alex's friends convinced her that she should break up with her girlfriend Tammy because Tammy spends too much time playing video games.
intention: Alex wants to break up with Tammy.
moral_action: Alex tells Tammy that the relationship isn't going to work out and that Tammy should find someone who shares her hobbies.
moral_consequence: Tammy is disappointed at the breakup but ends up meeting a new girl who loves playing video games.
immoral_action: Alex blocks Tammy's phone number and moves to a new apartment where she can't be found.
immoral_consequence: Tammy is panicked that something bad happened to Alex and calls the police.

norm: It is bad to abandon children.
situation: Cindy was at home with her children when her boss calls her into work.
intention: Cindy wants to work.
moral_action: Cindy drops off her children at the babysitter's when she goes to work.
moral_consequence: Cindy's children have a great time with the babysitter in a safe environment.
immoral_action: Cindy leaves her children at home when she goes to work.
immoral_consequence: Cindy's children manage to start a fire and almost burn down the house.

norm: It's bad to lie to your wife.
situation: Joe is married to a jealous woman who asks him who he has been texting as he is messaging a female friend.
intention: Joe wants to avoid getting in trouble with his wife.
moral_action: Joe is upfront about texting a female friend and lets her see the text to reassure her.
moral_consequence: Joe's wife is pleased he is being honest and feels satisfied.
immoral_action: Joe makes up that he is texting a male friend of his.
immoral_consequence: Joe's wife finds out who he was really texting and becomes even more jealous.

norm: It's hurtful to turn your siblings in to the police.
situation: Jerry has found out that his brother has just committed a serious crime of theft.
intention: Jerry wants to stop his brother from stealing.
moral_action: Jerry claims he will notify the police if he continues without actually intending to do so.
moral_consequence: Jerry's brother is scared of police involvement, so he stops committing crimes.
immoral_action: Jerry calls the police and files a report informing them who was responsible for the incident.
immoral_consequence: Jerry's brother feels betrayed and it ruins the relationship they have.

norm: You shouldn't trivialize actual mental issues people have.
situation: Terry notices that his coworker is counting to five between every action he completes in his work.
intention: Terry wants to address the fact that his coworker isn't getting enough work done, due to the counting behavior.
moral_action: Terry asks his coworker if he is experiencing any special difficulties in their work, that Terry could help them work around.
moral_consequence: His coworker explains that he has OCD but is working on finding ways to mitigate it's effect, he is very happy with Terry's offer to help.
immoral_action: Terry approaches his coworker and complains that they are acting completely crazy, and they need to speed up their work.
immoral_consequence: The coworker is offended and hurt by Terry's characterization of this behavior, which is not his fault.

norm: It's wrong not to have any friends.
situation: Jeremy is at a new school and is being introduced to the other children.
intention: Jeremy wants to say something to the other children.
moral_action: Jeremy tells the other children he likes to have fun, and they can hang out together.
moral_consequence: The other children will be open to spending time with Jeremy, and he will make new friends.
immoral_action: Jeremy tells the other children to stay away from him.
immoral_consequence: Jeremy will be lonely during school and the other children will think he's odd.

norm: It's bad to engage in credit card fraud.
situation: Johanna is a university student that is taking classes.
intention: Johanna wants to make money to pay for school books.
moral_action: Johanna gets a part time job on the weekend to earn money.
moral_consequence: Johanna buys the school books for class.
immoral_action: Johanna uses stolen credit cards to order school books online.
immoral_consequence: Johanna is caught by the FBI and sent to prison.

norm: It's kind to return someone's wallet when you find it.
situation: Dave is on an evening walk when he finds a wallet belonging to a man named Theo.
intention: Dave wants to take the wallet home.
moral_action: Dave goes home and looks up Theo's name on social media, then messages him to let him know he has his wallet.
moral_consequence: Theo is thoroughly relieved to have his wallet back and is able to pay his rent on time.
immoral_action: Dave goes home and takes the cash out of Theo's wallet before discarding it.
immoral_consequence: Theo loses all of his important documents as well as his rent money.

norm: You shouldn't lie on your dating bio.
situation: Charles is looking for a new girlfriend on a dating app that just came out.
intention: Charles wants his profile to be interesting.
moral_action: Charles writes a fun and unique story on his profile that involves his potential girlfriend.
moral_consequence: Women who love writing and fantasy are interested in his profile and message him.
immoral_action: Charles overestimates his income and how exciting his life is in the description he writes for his profile.
immoral_consequence: Women are disappointed when they meet Charles and find that he doesn't meet their expectation.

norm: It's rude to intrude in other people's photographs.
situation: Samantha is at her friend's wedding reception and the wedding party is taking photos while the guests celebrate.
intention: Samantha wants to have some pictures of herself taken to she can share them and remember this day.
moral_action: Samantha finds a spot away from the crowd and takes some selfies to post and share later.
moral_consequence: The bride and groom have many nice photos taken of them during the reception while the guests celebrate.
immoral_action: Samantha walks over to where the bride and groom are having their picture taken, and she gets in the photo with them.
immoral_consequence: The bride and groom are suprised Samantha has walked into their photos they have paid a lot to have taken.

norm: It's expected that partners will sleep in the same bed.
situation: Jill and her husband Lee bought a house and are setting it up.
intention: Jill wants to plan the sleeping arrangements.
moral_action: Jill sets up the master bedroom for her and Jim to share.
moral_consequence: Lee will feel happy that he's sharing a room with his wife.
immoral_action: Jill sets up a bedroom for herself separate from Lee.
immoral_consequence: Lee will feel that Jim doesn't love him that much.

norm: It's good to do chores on time.
situation: Jake's spouse tells Jake the house needs to be cleaned before tomorrow for a party.
intention: Jake wants to clean the house.
moral_action: Jake decides to clean the house seven hours early and finishes.
moral_consequence: The house is extremely clean, while Jake and Jake's spouse are thrilled.
immoral_action: Jake waits until right before the party to clean and barely manages to finish.
immoral_consequence: Jake's spouse gets angry at Jake for procrastinating, and they all feel stressed out.

norm: It's wrong to base your vote on gender.
situation: Bob wants to vote for a senator and sees that a questionable man and an upstanding woman are on the ballot.
intention: Bob wants to vote.
moral_action: Bob votes for the woman because he knows her character.
moral_consequence: The woman wins and does her job very well.
immoral_action: Bob votes for the man because he hates the thought of a woman in office.
immoral_consequence: The man wins and turns out to be terribly corrupt.

norm: It's rude to play your music too loudly.
situation: Ryan is a partier who lives in a duplex above a couple who work 9-5.
intention: Ryan wants to have friends over to party tonight.
moral_action: Ryan asks his friends to keep the noise level down and respect his neighbors.
moral_consequence: Ryan is able to spend the night with his friends while his neighbors sleep undisturbed.
immoral_action: Ryan turns up the volume on his surround sound speakers and dances the night away with friends.
immoral_consequence: Ryan's neighbors wake up in the middle of the night and miss work due to lack of sleep.

norm: One should drive carefully to avoid crashes.
situation: Jack is driving down a very narrow street as another car is approaching.
intention: Jack wants to finish his drive.
moral_action: Jack pulls over and lets the other car pass.
moral_consequence: Both cars proceed on their route safely.
immoral_action: Jack does not pull over and tries to drive past the other car.
immoral_consequence: Jack clips the other car and sends it tumbling into the woods.

norm: It is unusual to not miss your own children.
situation: Shane hasn't seen his kids since they moved out after college when a friend asks how they are doing.
intention: Shane wants to answer his friends question.
moral_action: Shane explains how hard it is not to see them, but he keeps in touch with them frequently.
moral_consequence: Shane's love for his kids is made apparent.
immoral_action: Shane tells his friend he has no idea how they are since he hasn't bothered to keep in touch.
immoral_consequence: Shane comes across as being cold hearted.

norm: It's kind to give gifts to others.
situation: Julie was invited to her 5 year old niece's birthday party.
intention: Julie wants to go to the party.
moral_action: Julie shows up to the party with a stuffed animal for her niece.
moral_consequence: Julie's niece feels loved by her aunt.
immoral_action: Julie shows up to the party without a gift.
immoral_consequence: Julie's niece is disappointed because everyone else brought a gift, so she thinks Julie doesn't like her.

norm: You shouldn't make illegal maneuvers while driving.
situation: John is driving with Nancy as his passenger and the're on the freeway in the middle lane.
intention: John wants to merge into the left most lane.
moral_action: John turns on his indicator and checks his mirrors before starting the lane change.
moral_consequence: Nancy is happy that she is being driven by a safe driver and feels no danger.
immoral_action: John immediately swerves into the left lane without signaling or looking in his blind spot.
immoral_consequence: Nancy is terrified and fears for her life as her stress goes to maximum instantly as the car screeches along.

norm: It's good to make and stick to goals.
situation: Bobby has graduated high school and has been accepted into his college of choice.
intention: Bobby wants to start college in order to work towards a career.
moral_action: Bobby starts college and even though the first few semesters are hard he perseveres and completes college.
moral_consequence: Bobby is able to use his college degree and lands a high paying job after graduation.
immoral_action: Bobby starts college but after the first semester drops out gives up on his goal and does not graduate.
immoral_consequence: Bobby is forced to find a lower paying job as he does not have a college degree.

norm: It is wrong to be happy over elderly people dying.
situation: Billy is sitting in the break room talking with some coworkers about getting promoted.
intention: Billy wants to move up in his company.
moral_action: Billy picks the mind of a coworker who is several tiers above him in the company heirachy.
moral_consequence: Billy learns some valuable tips on how to be a better and more valued employee to his company.
immoral_action: A coworker notes that an older high-level employee recently passed and Billy comments how great that is because now there will a chance to get a promotion.
immoral_consequence: Billy is sent to HR and written up for his rude comment about the old person's death.

norm: It's best not to get involved in fights between others.
situation: Robert is walking on the street with a friend on a Saturday evening and sees two men fighting in front of a bar.
intention: Robert wants the men to stop fighting with each other.
moral_action: Robert decides not to intervene directly and instead calls the police.
moral_consequence: Robert is safe and happy that the fight is over.
immoral_action: Robert walks between the two men and pushes them away from each other.
immoral_consequence: The two men are angry at his intervention, and they gang up on him, hurting him.

norm: It's good to love your family.
situation: Dean is away from his family on a week long business trip and is currently in his hotel room.
intention: Dean wants to explore the city he is staying in.
moral_action: Dean video-calls his family and gives them a tour of the city while he goes sight-seeing.
moral_consequence: Dean's family feels loved, and they are exuberant when he returns home.
immoral_action: Dean uses the trip to explore the new city and isolate himself from his family by not answering any of their calls or texts throughout the entire trip.
immoral_consequence: Dean's family feels neglected but welcomes him back when the trip is over.

norm: It's bad to pee on your bed.
situation: Zach is half-awake in his bed around midnight after having had a large cup of tea before bed.
intention: Zach wants to pee.
moral_action: Zach gets up and goes to the bathroom to pee.
moral_consequence: Zach feels relieved and goes back to bed where he sleeps soundly.
immoral_action: Zach pees in his bed before going back to sleep.
immoral_consequence: Zach sleeps poorly as his sheets are all wet with pee, and he has to wash them the next day.

norm: It's good for siblings to be honest with each other.
situation: Mary asks her brother Harry what he thinks of the oversized flower dress from her closet.
intention: Harry wants to give an opinion on the dress.
moral_action: Harry tells Mary that the dress doesn't suit her that well.
moral_consequence: Mary looks for a better dress in the closet to wear.
immoral_action: Harry tells Mary that the dress looks great on her.
immoral_consequence: Mary wears the dress to school and everyone teases her.

norm: It is bad to do a lot of drugs.
situation: Josh is a freshman at a college who joins a fraternity.
intention: Josh wants to experiment and live the college life.
moral_action: Josh goes to parties and drinks in moderation but stays away from the hard drugs.
moral_consequence: Josh stays on track ot graduate and gets a degree four years later.
immoral_action: Josh does drugs daily and develops an addiction to a couple of them.
immoral_consequence: Josh is expelled from college and must go to a rehab center.

norm: You should not bother your friends excessively.
situation: Jeff's friend owes him $20.
intention: Jeff wants his friend to pay him back.
moral_action: Jeff reminds his friend about the money the day before they are scheduled to get together.
moral_consequence: Jeff's friends remembers to bring the money and pay Jeff back.
immoral_action: Jeff sends his friend multiple texts every day about the money.
immoral_consequence: Jeff's friend gets annoyed with Jeff and does not pay him pack.

norm: It's wrong not to have sex with your pregnant wife.
situation: Samantha and her husband haven't had sex for a few months, since she found out she was pregnant.
intention: Samantha wants some sexual release.
moral_action: Samantha asks her husband to have sex, even though she's very pregnant.
moral_consequence: Samantha's husband agrees, wanting to please his beautiful pregnant wife.
immoral_action: Samantha asks her husband for sex, he says not while she's pregnant, so she uses a vibrator.
immoral_consequence: Samantha feels undervalued and underloved by her husband, rethinking the relationship.

norm: It's rude to leave loved ones hanging.
situation: Mary is on a phone call with her loving brother and while on the phone with him, gets another call from her insurance.
intention: Mary wants to deal with the incoming call somehow.
moral_action: Mary deals with the incoming call by telling insurance to call back later and immediately jumps back into conversation with her brother.
moral_consequence: Mary's brother in appreciative of Mary that she values his time and has a great conversation with her.
immoral_action: Mary deals with the new incoming call by telling her brother to wait for her to finish talking to insurance.
immoral_consequence: Mary's brother is upset at Mary for making him wait and lets her know afterward.

norm: It's rude to gossip about your neighbors.
situation: Yolanda lives next to Tracy and is frustrated by her dog which barks every morning.
intention: Yolanda wants to react to the barking.
moral_action: Yolanda talks to Tracy directly about her dog barking every morning.
moral_consequence: Tracy feels sorry and apologizes to Yolanda.
immoral_action: Yolanda complained Tracy's dog to her other neighbor, who later tells Tracy about the complaint.
immoral_consequence: Tracy feels embarrassed and bad.

norm: It is bad to take what isn't yours.
situation: John is out shopping for a wedding ring but is short on cash.
intention: John sees an expensive ring he really likes and decides he needs it.
moral_action: John signs up for a payment plan for the ring.
moral_consequence: John is thrilled when his girlfriend says she loves the ring.
immoral_action: John breaks into the jewelry case, grabs the ring and makes a run for it.
immoral_consequence: John is later tracked down by the police and arrested.

norm: It's inappropriate to punch a lot of people.
situation: Sam gets into a heated argument with a group of men at a bar after he accidentally bumps into one of them.
intention: Sam wants to resolve the dispute.
moral_action: Sam defuses the situation with words and offers to buy the men a round of drinks.
moral_consequence: Sam enjoys the rest of his evening before heading back home.
immoral_action: Sam starts a fight, kicking and punching the men with his fists.
immoral_consequence: The police are called and Sam is arrested for assault.

norm: It's wrong for parents to mistreat their kids.
situation: Hank was upset with his son Bobby for his report card.
intention: Hank wants Bobby to learn something.
moral_action: Hank decides to get Bobby a tutor for school and make him study.
moral_consequence: Bobby's grades improve over time as he learns more about the subjects.
immoral_action: Hank locks Bobby in his room until his grades improve.
immoral_consequence: Bobby's grades do improve but Bobby doesn't wanna talk to Hank.

norm: It's wrong to sell items under false pretense.
situation: Jerry works as a car salesman and James has come in to buy a car.
intention: Jerry wants to sell James a car.
moral_action: Jerry sells James a car that he looking for at a reasonable price.
moral_consequence: James leaves the lot happy.
immoral_action: Jerry sells James a bad car with a very inflated price to make a profit, claiming that it is great.
immoral_consequence: James wastes his money and gets a bad car.

norm: It is rude to throw a football at someone.
situation: Joe gets into an argument with Roy during football practice.
intention: Joe wants to end the argument.
moral_action: Joe walks away from Roy while he is still talking.
moral_consequence: Joe doesn't converse with Roy for the rest of the practice session.
immoral_action: Joe pick up a football and throws it at Roy's head.
immoral_consequence: Joe is sent home from football practice early for hitting Roy.

norm: It's wrong to take advantage of the community
situation: Megan is a single mother that often has financial issues, but recently won a large sum of cash.
intention: Megan wants to get better furniture for her home.
moral_action: Megan takes a small portion of her earnings to buy the furniture and declines help from the community group while she has extra cash.
moral_consequence: The community group tells Megan to let them know when she does need assistance, and they will be able to aid her then.
immoral_action: Megan is approached by a community group that helps single mothers that have financial struggles and Megan tells them she can't afford new furniture.
immoral_consequence: The community group finds out by the store clerk the amount of money Megan recently won and no longer will help her in the future after Megan's funds are depleted.

norm: It's wrong not to acknowledge your parents.
situation: Joe has been living with his parents but just got a good job.
intention: Joe wants to live on his own.
moral_action: Joe moves out on his own near to his parents and calls them every day to talk.
moral_consequence: Joe's parents feel loved by Joe and happy too.
immoral_action: Joe moves across the country and settles down and doesn't bother to ever call his folks.
immoral_consequence: Joe's parents are sad and wonder if Joe still loves them.

norm: It is rude to second guess medical professionals.
situation: Tim's doctor wants him to wear a mask because he should partake in stopping the spread of a virus.
