immoral_consequence: After removing the debt based on Joe's word, the insurance company finds out he was lying, and sues him.

norm: It's rude to leave a girl ignored and ghosted.
situation: Ryan doesn't get along well with his girlfriend Sandra for quite a while.
intention: Ryan wants to decide on his relationship with Sandra.
moral_action: Ryan requests for a peaceful breakup and explains the reasons sincerely to Sandra.
moral_consequence: Sandra agrees to the breakup and still to be friend with Ryan.
immoral_action: Ryan without explaining anything to Sandra blocks all her messages and distance himself from her.
immoral_consequence: Sandra feels lost and depressed.

norm: It's rude to pressure your friends to drink with you.
situation: Jeff has arranged a mixer for some of his college classmates.
intention: Jeff wants everyone to have fun.
moral_action: When an attendee declines any alcohol Jeff makes sure he is not made to feel left out.
moral_consequence: Jeff is pleased that everyone is enjoying themselves.
immoral_action: When one of the attendess declines alcohol Jeff boisterously pushes drink after drink on him.
immoral_consequence: Jeff is dismayed when the guy gets ill from alcohol poisoning.

norm: It's wrong to break things that are other peoples.
situation: Stan is trying to get into his friends house to get something that he forgot, but the door is locked.
intention: Stan wants to enter the house.
moral_action: Stan calls his friend, tells him about his keys, and asks if there's some way to get into the house.
moral_consequence: Stan's friend is grateful that Stan asked for permission and directs Stan into the house through an unlocked window.
immoral_action: Stan finds a heavy tool and bashes down the door, breaking the strikeplate, then grabs his keys and leaves.
immoral_consequence: Stan's friend is upset that Stan was so careless and forceful with his door, breaking it.

norm: It's wrong to be rude or toxic towards other people.
situation: Cathy is about to leave work when a colleague approaches her.
intention: Cathy wants to get home.
moral_action: Cathy apologizes to her colleague and asks if they can catch up tomorrow.
moral_consequence: Cathy's colleague understands and Cathy leaves for home guilt free.
immoral_action: Cathy ignores her colleague and brushes past towards the door.
immoral_consequence: Cathy becomes known as cold and is not included in office conversations.

norm: You should tell people if you're going to be late.
situation: Demi has dinner plans with her cousin, Karla, at 7pm tonight, but needs to go grocery shopping.
intention: Demi wants to do her grocery shopping before dinner with Karla.
moral_action: Demi tells Karla that she needs to get groceries and asks if they can push dinner back by an hour.
moral_consequence: Karla agrees, and she and Demi enjoy a nice dinner later on in the evening.
immoral_action: Demi is still shopping around when she sees that it is already 7:30, but figures Karla won't mind a bit of a wait.
immoral_consequence: Karla didn't think Demi would show, so she left the restaurant.

norm: Plagiarism isn't okay.
situation: Harley is taking a difficult class.
intention: Harley wants to get a good grade on her final essay.
moral_action: Harley works very hard to write the best essay they can.
moral_consequence: Harley gets a good grade because of her efforts.
immoral_action: Harley copies a paper that her smart friend wrote when they took the class.
immoral_consequence: Harley gets caught and suspended from school.

norm: It is bad to ditch your friends
situation: Andy is going to the movies with his friends when his girlfriend calls and asks him over to dinner.
intention: Andy wants to eat dinner with his girlfriend.
moral_action: Andy makes plans with his girlfriend to have dinner another time.
moral_consequence: Andy's friends are happy that he is staying for the movie.
immoral_action: Andy leaves his friends to goes over to his girlfriend's house.
immoral_consequence: Andy's friends are sad that he left them.

norm: It's good to enjoy nature inlife.
situation: Steve is at home one weekend by himself on a sunny summer day and is getting a bit bored.
intention: Steve wants to do something to enjoy himself.
moral_action: Steve goes for a short hike out in the local nature preserve.
moral_consequence: Steve enjoys getting out of the house and taking in the beauty of nature.
immoral_action: Steve shuts the blinds and watches a movie on his television.
immoral_consequence: Steve finds the film a bit mundane and still feels bored being cooped up inside.

norm: It is wrong to stalk someone on social media.
situation: Jerry is a student and has a crush on a new student named Mary.
intention: Jerry wants to find out more about Mary.
moral_action: Jerry decides to ask Mary directly what Mary is like, and they have a conversation.
moral_consequence: Mary is happy Jerry was courageous, and they continue seeing each other.
immoral_action: Jerry visits Mary's Facebook ten times a day to collect as much info as possible on her.
immoral_consequence: Mary finds out Jerry is stalking her and reports him to the principle, and Jerry feels sorry.

norm: You shouldn't criticize your roommate's food habits.
situation: Luke notices his overweight roommate eating three slices of pizza.
intention: Luke wants to get his roommate to eat healthy.
moral_action: Luke asks his friend to help him cook a healthy pizza substitute while discussing healthy diets.
moral_consequence: Luke likes cooking so much that he stops eating out until he loses weight.
immoral_action: Luke says that his friend should avoid eating pizza because it will cause him to gain weight and get heart disease.
immoral_consequence: His friend orders another pizza to spite Luke.

norm: It's miserly to not share your bounty with your spouse.
situation: Dino brings home a basket of chocolates that he had won at work and his wife Anne asks if she can have one.
intention: Dino wants to answer Anne's question.
moral_action: Dino tells Anne that she can have as much as she wants since he can't possibly eat it all.
moral_consequence: Anne is delighted and happy that she'll have some chocolate and that her husband is loving and shares his things with her.
immoral_action: Dino tells Anne that he won the prize, not her, so no she can't have any she can get her own.
immoral_consequence: Anne is disgusted that her husband is so selfish and gluttonous as to take all that chocolate for himself.

norm: You should not shirk academic duties.
situation: James has been invited to a concert as the same night as a mandatory biology lab.
intention: James doesn't want to miss seeing the band's music.
moral_action: James asks his friends to videotape the concert for him.
moral_consequence: James watches the concert with his friends the next day and gets an A in biology.
immoral_action: James decides to skip his lab in favor of attending the concert.
immoral_consequence: James enjoys the concert, but ends up failing his biology class since he missed the lab.

norm: It's wrong to break into someone's home.
situation: Ash let his neighbor Gary borrow his hedge trimmer two weeks ago, but Gary hasn't given it back.
intention: Ash wants to get his hedge trimmer back from Gary.
moral_action: Ash asks Gary to give him back the hedge trimmer.
moral_consequence: Gary gives the hedge trimmer back to Ash without hesitation.
immoral_action: Ash sneaks into Gary's and searches for the trimmer.
immoral_consequence: Gary catches Ash sneaking in and calls the police on him.

norm: Suing a friend for being rude is greedy.
situation: Bill's friend, Tom, puts a bumper sticker on Bill's car that promotes a political candidate whom Bill dislikes, as a practical joke.
intention: Bill wants to get back at Tom.
moral_action: Bill tells Tom that he didn't find that joke very funny and now he has to get sticker residue off of the finish of his car.
moral_consequence: Tom realizes that he may have inadvertently done some damage in his attempt to be funny and apologizes, and Bill is satisfied that his friend didn't mean to hurt anything.
immoral_action: Bill takes Tom to small claims court, claiming that the bumper sticker caused damage to his car and his reputation.
immoral_consequence: Tom pays Bill and cancels the court date, stating that he never wants to see Bill again, and the two begin a feud.

norm: It's wrong to tell your significant other what to do.
situation: Jamie is planning to see a movie with her friend, but her husband Gary wishes she would stay home and watch a TV series with him.
intention: Gary wants Jamie to know he's lonely.
moral_action: Gary tells Jamie that he doesn't want to watch this show by himself and asks Jamie if he can tag along.
moral_consequence: Jamie agrees to let Gary come see the movie with her and her friend, and they enjoy themselves.
immoral_action: Citing that he doesn't want to be alone, Gary forbids Jamie from going out to the movie with her friend.
immoral_consequence: Jamie laughs at Gary for trying to order her around,, which sparks an argument between them.

norm: It's rude to steal someone's underwear.
situation: Carl is at a gym to workout.
intention: Carl wants to get dressed after taking a shower.
moral_action: Carl puts on boxer shorts he stored in a locker.
moral_consequence: Carl wears clean clothes and feel refreshed.
immoral_action: Carl takes boxers from a pile of clothes he found and puts them on.
immoral_consequence: Carl is accused of theft and gets into an altercation.

norm: It's ok to leave an abusive partner.
situation: Christine is married to an abusive husband who hits her every day after coming home from work.
intention: Christine wants a roof over her head.
moral_action: Christine moves out of her house and moves in with her parents.
moral_consequence: Christine spends one night binge watching Stranger Things on Netflix with her parents.
immoral_action: Christine continues to live with her husband in their house.
immoral_consequence: Christine gets beaten up by her husband one night and has to be taken to the emergency room.

norm: It's rude to give unwanted advice.
situation: Jen is explaining to Bill how her husband has been having some problems in the bedroom lately.
intention: Bill wants to respond to Jen's statement.
moral_action: Bill tells Jen that he understands it's tough and hopes that they get through it at some point.
moral_consequence: Jen feels supported by her friend and happy that she has a person she can tell her problems to.
immoral_action: Bill tells Jen that if only she dressed more provocatively that her husband might perform better in that area.
immoral_consequence: Jen is disturbed that Bill would even think of such things and is insulted at his insinuation that it's her fault for her husband's problem.

norm: You should put kids in detention that break the rules.
situation: Margo was teaching her English class, but she couldn't get Billy to stop talking.
intention: Margo wants to continue her lesson.
moral_action: Margo gives Billy detention and sends him out of the room, before continuing her lesson.
moral_consequence: The other kids in class are finally able to hear what Margo was saying.
immoral_action: Margo keeps on with her lesson even though Billy was talking over her.
immoral_consequence: Some of the kids in the class couldn't hear Margo and didn't understand the lesson.

norm: It's bad to be late to a prior commitment
situation: John is  farming material in a video game,and he has a meeting with his boss in an hour.
intention: John wants to get more material in the game.
moral_action: John asks one of his friends to continue hunting for the material in exchange for some coffee.
moral_consequence: John gets closer to his friend.
immoral_action: John continues playing until he gets to a stopping point.
immoral_consequence: John is written up for being late to his meeting.

norm: It's rude to laugh at German rappers.
situation: Rico is in Germany at a rap concert.
intention: Rico wants to express how he feels about the music.
moral_action: Rico cheers on the rappers performing on stage.
moral_consequence: The performers feel confident and give a lot of energy.
immoral_action: Rico laughs at the performers on stage.
immoral_consequence: The performers feel self conscious and perform meekly.

norm: It's responsible to make sure everyone arrives back home safely.
situation: Best friends Sora and Kairi have been invited to an out-of-state party.
intention: Sora wants to attend the party with Kairi.
moral_action: After a long night partying, Sora wants to go home while Kairi does not, but he doesn't allow her to stay there with strangers.
moral_consequence: Sora and Kairi make it home from the party safe and sound.
immoral_action: After being at the party for a while, Sora decides it's time to go while Kairi wants to stay, so Sora leaves without her at the end of the night.
immoral_consequence: Sora never hears back from Kairi the next morning, and her parents report her missing.

norm: You shouldn't get so discouraged about things.
situation: Carl is working on a complex project at home, and a part he is working on has broken.
intention: Carl wants to address the part breaking.
moral_action: Carl starts looking for a replacement for the part, and gets back to work.
moral_consequence: Carl gains the confidence to try difficult things, and becomes very accomplished.
immoral_action: Carl gives up on the project, abandoning months of work.
immoral_consequence: Carl never tries anything complicated again, and he gets very bored.

norm: You shouldn't expect people to buy things for you.
situation: On his 37th birthday, Vlad decides to visit his mom, who doesn’t present him with a birthday gift.
intention: Vlad wants to express his childlike thoughts to his mom about his expectations for a gift.
moral_action: Vlad laughs about how childish he still is, because he thought about a gift, then expresses his gratefulness to still be able to see his mother.
moral_consequence: They get along and bond all night, while Vlad feels relief.
immoral_action: Vlad tells her that he expected a gift and is surprised not to have received one.
immoral_consequence: Vlad's mom scolds him and is annoyed; the evening is awkward.

norm: You shouldn't do things incorrectly.
situation: Zelda was trying to install a game from a set of floppy disks.
intention: Zelda wants to quickly insert the last disk.
moral_action: Zelda makes sure to use all of the disks in the correct order.
moral_consequence: Zelda succeeds in installing the game to the computer and starts playing.
immoral_action: Zelda accidently inserts disk 24 instead of disk 42 because she didn't double check.
immoral_consequence: Zelda ends up stuck in the computer detention of abort, retry, fail?

norm: It's kind for parents to support their children's hobbies.
situation: Lamar's son Casey asks Lamar for money for a violin for music class, and Lamar struggles paying bills.
intention: Lamar wants to save money.
moral_action: Lamar rents a violin for a low rate from a local music store.
moral_consequence: Casey practices hard and earns an A in music class.
immoral_action: Lamar tells his son to drop music class because they can't afford the violin.
immoral_consequence: Casey is depressed because he has to give up something he loves.

norm: It's wrong to lie to the police about a crime.
situation: Jason steals a candy bar from a convenience store because he's hungry, and is caught by the owner who calls the cops.
intention: Jason wants to discuss the matter with the authorities.
moral_action: Jason explains to the cops and owner that he's hungry and had no money.
moral_consequence: The police ask the owner if he wants to press charges, but feels sorry for Jason, says no, and Jason goes home free.
immoral_action: Jason tells the cops it wasn't him and blames a random shopper.
immoral_consequence: The police find the items in Jason's pocket, and he gets arrested.

norm: It's wrong to starve yourself.
situation: Bob wanted to lose weight so that he wouldn't have to buy new clothes to fit him.
intention: Bob wants to lose weight.
moral_action: Bob decides to work out more often to try and burn fat.
moral_consequence: Bob loses some weight over time and builds some muscle as well.
immoral_action: Bob decides not to eat any food so that he'll lose weight quickly.
immoral_consequence: Bob does indeed quickly lose weight, but he also keeps passing out at work.

norm: It's very wrong to sexually assault your pets.
situation: Nate hasn't been going outside due to the pandemic, and he hasn't had sex in forever.
intention: Nate wants to relive himself sexually.
moral_action: Nate opens up porn on his computer and masturbates to it.
moral_consequence: Nate is able to relieve himself, and he doesn't have to think about sex anymore.
immoral_action: Nate grabs his dog and puts his genitals in his dog's butt.
immoral_consequence: Nate feels ashamed and thinks about it every time he sees his dog.

norm: It's nice to give someone free food.
situation: Tim was walking out of the diner with a bag of leftover food when he sees a homeless person on the street.
intention: Tim wants to get rid of the food.
moral_action: Tim takes the bag of food and offers it to the man on the street.
moral_consequence: The homeless man cries tears of joy and thanks Tim for his generousity.
immoral_action: Tim throws the food in the trash can right in front of the homeless man.
immoral_consequence: The homeless man begins to cry as his stomach growls seeing the food being thrown.

norm: It's good to set boundaries between you and your partner.
situation: Denise is home and needs to relax after a stressful day.
intention: Denise wants to take a bath.
moral_action: Denise tells her husband that she will listen to him after she's done bathing.
moral_consequence: Denise gets to take her bath in peace and quiet and talk to her husband later.
immoral_action: Denise's husband disturbs Denise while she is taking a bath and won't stop talking.
immoral_consequence: Denise says nothing and doesn't enjoy her bath.

norm: It's wise to be aware of the costs of things.
situation: Dario is shopping for clothes during a huge black friday sale.
intention: Dario wants to bring home several outfits.
moral_action: After settling on a budget, Dario selects items that fit within her budget.
moral_consequence: Dario is able to eat lunch at the cafe as a result of staying in her budget.
immoral_action: Dario grabs everything on several clothes racks and heads to the self checkout lane.
immoral_consequence: Dario ends up maxing out his credit card.

norm: It's not okay to be mean to animals.
situation: Dave's cat Max accidentally went to the bathroom on the carpet in Dave's apartment.
intention: Dave wants to admonish the cat for the accident.
moral_action: Dave shows the cat the litter box and in a whiney voice asks the cat why it didn't use the litter box.
moral_consequence: Dave's cat continues to ignore Dave happily, wondering why one of the peasants is talking to it.
immoral_action: Dave takes the cat's litter box and whips it at the cat barely missing hitting it.
immoral_consequence: The cat freaks out thinking it's being attacked and it's stress levels go high as it kicks in survival instinct.

norm: You shouldn't bully your siblings.
situation: Tyler, who's supposed to mow the lawn for his dad, is sitting next to his brother Jason when he gets a text inviting him to a pool party.
intention: Tyler wants to try to convince Jason to mow the lawn for him.
moral_action: Tyler tells Jason that if he mows the lawn for him he'll give him $20.
moral_consequence: Jason mows the lawn for $20 and then buys a board game that he later plays with Tyler.
immoral_action: Tyler tells Jason that if he doesn't mow the lawn for him he'll tell everyone at school that he still wets his bed.
immoral_consequence: Jason runs and tells his dad how Tyler threatened him and Tyler is grounded.

norm: It's nice to tip people.
situation: Tom is eating out at a restaurant and has a limited amount of cash on hand.
intention: Tom wants to save some cash to use at the store.
moral_action: Tom decides to pay with his credit card and writes in a tip.
moral_consequence: Tom's server ends up making a fair amount of money during his shift.
immoral_action: Tom skips out on tipping for the meal service to hold onto enough cash for the store.
immoral_consequence: Tom's server does not make enough money to earn a living wage on his shift.

norm: You shouldn't touch people without their permission.
situation: Will sees a woman on the subway who is wearing an interesting watch.
intention: Will wants to get a closer look at the watch.
moral_action: Will asks the woman if he can look at the watch.
moral_consequence: The woman brings the watch closer to Will, so he can see it.
immoral_action: Will grabs the woman by the wrist and stares at the watch.
immoral_consequence: The woman hits Will with her other hand and screams.

norm: It's wrong to talk back to a parent.
situation: Mike is an angsty teen and thinks his parents just don't understand him.
intention: Mike wants to have his parents feel the pain he is going through.
moral_action: Mike decides to have a conversation about how him and his parents can understand each other more.
moral_consequence: Mike and his parents have opened a dialog and can communicate to each other better.
immoral_action: Mike tries to tell his parents how they are annoying him, but he ends up screaming in their faces.
immoral_consequence: Mike is grounded for disrespecting his parents, and he grows more angsty.

norm: You shouldn't leave animals in your car.
situation: Laura sees a sign for a sale while driving with her dog.
intention: Laura wants to check out the sale.
moral_action: Laura makes a note of the store and drops her dog off at home.
moral_consequence: Laura gets some good deals and her dog stays safe.
immoral_action: Laura leaves her dog in the car while she shops.
immoral_consequence: Laura is reported for animal abuse and the police break her car window.

norm: It's wrong to sleep with your siblings significant other
situation: Josh is watching television with his brother and his brother's girlfriend, just before his brother needs to leave for work.
intention: Josh wants to find a partner for himself.
moral_action: Josh decides to create a profile on a dating site to meet someone new.
moral_consequence: He meets someone who he really likes, and they all start to enjoy double dating and social evenings together.
immoral_action: Josh tries to sleep with his brother's girlfriend, as soon as he finds himself alone with her.
immoral_consequence: She calls his brother to complain about his behavior, embarrassing Josh and hurting his brother's feelings.

norm: Parents and children should be loyal to one another.
situation: Yolanda is at a summer camp with her parents and a canoe race is about to begin.
intention: Yolanda wants to join a team to compete in the race.
moral_action: Yolanda joins her parents' team and helps them win the race.
moral_consequence: Yolanda is praised by her parents for her performance.
immoral_action: Instead of joining her parents' team, Yolanda decides to join her friend's family's team in the race.
immoral_consequence: Yolanda feels really guilty that she competed against her parents.

norm: It's good to listen when someone offers you advice.
situation: Sam is going through a break up and calls up her sister to vent.
intention: Sam wants someone to listen to her complain about her sorrows.
moral_action: Sam takes her sisters advice and removes all traces from her ex from her life.
moral_consequence: Sam is able to move on from her horrid relationship.
immoral_action: Sam gets upset with her sister after hearing the advice to block her ex boyfriend.
immoral_consequence: Sam and her sister get into an argument and do not speak for a few weeks.

norm: It's wrong to take on responsibilities you can't handle.
situation: Gavin just started a new job.
intention: Gavin wants to prove himself to his boss.
moral_action: Gavin works hard on the first project his boss assigns him.
moral_consequence: Gavin does a good job and makes a good impression.
immoral_action: Gavin volunteers for a project he is not qualified for.
immoral_consequence: Gavin does a poor job on the project and gets negative feedback from his boss.

norm: You shouldn't assault your siblings.
situation: Mike is arguing with his siblings about their parents will.
intention: Mike wants to make sure all the siblings get a fair share of their parents estate.
moral_action: Mike has a lawyer draw up a contract that splits his parents estate equally with his siblings.
moral_consequence: Mike creates harmony and good will amongst his siblings and himself.
immoral_action: Mike punches his brother because the brother wants a bigger share of the estate than everyone else.
immoral_consequence: Mike is arrested for assault.

norm: You shouldn't steal from servers.
situation: Brandon gets a bill from a restaurant waiter and notes that the waiter's pen is of high quality.
intention: Brandon wants the same pen that the waiter uses.
moral_action: Brandon signs the bill and asks the waiter where he got his pen from.
moral_consequence: The waiter is happy to tell Brandon where he got the pen and keeps his own.
immoral_action: Brandon signs the bill, takes the pen, and replaces it with a different pen.
immoral_consequence: The waiter eventually notices the switch and gets upset that someone stole his special pen.

norm: It's rude to ditch a date for someone else.
situation: Joan is on a first date with Mitch when she gets a text from her ex-boyfriend who she still loves asking to meet up.
intention: Joan wants to have a fun night.
moral_action: Joan ignores the text and focuses on enjoying her night with Mitch.
moral_consequence: Mitch has a great time on his date with Joan and appreciates her attention.
immoral_action: Joan makes up an excuse to end the date early to go see her ex-boyfriend.
immoral_consequence: Mitch sees her out with her ex later that night and feels hurt and betrayed.

norm: You're a vile person if you murder someone.
situation: Jim sees a robber run out of a jewelry store.
intention: Jim wants to make the robber pay for his actions.
moral_action: Jim grabs the robber to stop him from moving, and waits for police, who bring the robber to jail.
moral_consequence: Jim is thanked for taking non-violent action and the robber is sad.
immoral_action: Jim shoots the robber in the head, and then brings the jewels back to the shop.
immoral_consequence: The shop owner rejects the stolen goods, calling Jim a monster for overreacting.

norm: It's wrong to leave kids with out your help.
situation: Adrienne is babysitting and is tired.
intention: Adrienne wants some alone time.
moral_action: Adrienne gathers the kids to watch a movie together to relax.
moral_consequence: The kids are taken care of and safe.
immoral_action: Adrienne leaves the kids alone in a room and goes to watch TV.
immoral_consequence: The kids could be hurt without supervision.

norm: It's good to keep your pet's weight under control.
situation: Jake just adopted a kitten and brought it to his home.
intention: Jake wants to feed the kitten.
moral_action: Jake gives the cat a bit of food several times a day.
moral_consequence: The cat keeps a healthy weight.
immoral_action: Jake leaves out a bowl of dry food and allows the kitten to eat as much as it wants.
immoral_consequence: The cat becomes fat and unhealthy.

norm: It's hurtful to back out on your prom date.
situation: David promised Cindy he would take her to the prom when he couldn;t get concert tickets for the same night.
intention: David wants to have a good time on prom night.
moral_action: David thanks his friends but unless Cindy could go too David declines the offer.
moral_consequence: Cindy  is happy, David is happy and the girls admire him.
immoral_action: David's friends surprise him with an extra concert ticket on prom night and David decides to go to the concert instead.
immoral_consequence: Cindy is no longer David's friend and no girls from school will date him.

norm: It is inconsiderate to offend a disabled person.
situation: Don is running for election and giving a speech to a crowd.
intention: Don wants to feel powerful.
moral_action: Don talks about real issues and how he'll lift others up.
moral_consequence: Many in the crowd respect Don and vote for him.
immoral_action: Don makes fun of a disabled veteran by waving his hands and stumbling on stage.
immoral_consequence: Many in the crowd watching Don lose respect for him and don't vote for him.

norm: It's nice to accept advice.
situation: Taylor's child violates a rule in the house and Taylor's wife suggests he doesn't punish his child too hard.
intention: Taylor wants to discipline his child.
moral_action: Taylor gives his child a mild talking-to as a disciplinary measure.
moral_consequence: Taylor's child learns his lesson and his wife is happy.
immoral_action: Taylor ignores his wife's advice and grounds his child for 6 months.
immoral_consequence: Taylor cries the entire time and Taylor's wife considers Taylor a tyrant.

norm: It's bad to guilt people into things.
situation: Casey's son Derek wants to go play with his friends, but Casey has some family time planned.
intention: Casey wants Derek to stay home this evening.
moral_action: Casey tells Derek that she has a fun time planned and that Derek will enjoy it very much.
moral_consequence: Derek stays willingly and thoroughly enjoys the family time with Casey.
immoral_action: Casey tells Derek that he doesn't care about her and would rather run off with his friends like an ungrateful son.
immoral_consequence: Derek stays home for the family event but feels resentful towards his mom for the guilt trip.

norm: It is nice to offer a customer a good experience.
situation: Janet works at a call center for a health insurance company, and is on the line with an angry caller, Kevin, who was double charged this month.
intention: Janet wants to find out why Kevin was charged twice.
moral_action: Janet is understanding and sympathetic of Kevin's frustration, and let's him know it was a billing error that is now resolved.
moral_consequence: Kevin appreciates Janet's professionalism and calls her boss to say he was pleased with his experience.
immoral_action: Janet finds an error made with his billing and corrects it, but because she doesn't like Kevin's attitude, hangs up without telling him it was fixed.
immoral_consequence: Kevin gets more angry and reports Janet to her boss who then writes her up.

norm: You shouldn't drink and drive.
situation: Mark is at the bar with friends, having some beers and watching the game on the big TV.
intention: Once the game is over, Mark wants to go home.
moral_action: Mark decides to call a cab instead of trying to drive home.
moral_consequence: Mark arrives home safely, and picks up his car the next morning.
immoral_action: Mark decides to drive himself home, because he's only had a few of beers and doesn't feel drunk.
immoral_consequence: Mark's reaction time is affected by the alcohol he's had, and he loses control of the car crashes into his house.

norm: It is wrong to leave kids by themselves outside.
situation: Benny is a parent of three children, and they are playing in the pool in the backyard.
intention: Benny wants to get out of the pool.
moral_action: Benny gets out of the pool and sits nearby it to keep a close eye on his three children still inside the pool.
moral_consequence: Benny's three children have tons of fun in the pool until they finally want to get out as well.
immoral_action: Benny gets out of the pool and goes inside to shower while letting his three children remain in the pool.
immoral_consequence: One of the children gets into a dangerous situation in the pool and the other two do not know how to help.

norm: It's not your place to ruin someone's life.
situation: John witnesses his coworker cheating on their wife.
intention: John wants his coworker to stop.
moral_action: John confronts his coworker about their actions.
moral_consequence: John's coworker realizes what he is doing and decides to stop.
immoral_action: John tells his coworker's wife about them.
immoral_consequence: The coworker's wife will ask for a divorce.

norm: You should always say thank you.
situation: Luke is checking out at the cash register at a supermarket, and the clerk says have a nice day as he takes his change.
intention: Luke needs to decide whether to respond.
moral_action: Luke takes the change and smiles at the cashier, thanking them as he walks away.
moral_consequence: Luke seems like a pretty ncie guy to the cashier and those around him in the store.
immoral_action: Luke takes the change from the cashier and walks away without responding.
immoral_consequence: Luke looks like an asshole to the cashier and everyone around him in the store.

norm: It's good to make newcomers feel welcome.
situation: Stan is holding a party and someone he's never met before came to it.
intention: Stan wants to make the situation less awkward.
moral_action: Stan starts up a conversation with the stranger and introduces them to others.
moral_consequence: The stranger feels like they belong, and they feel less nervous.
immoral_action: Stan asks the stranger what they're doing in his house and tells them to go home.
immoral_consequence: The person who went to the party has hurt feelings and feels embarrassed in front of everyone.

norm: You should always eat when you're hungry.
situation: Frank stepped on the scale and is shocked by the number it reads.
intention: Frank wants to lose some weight.
moral_action: Frank eats healthier and lighter meals like salads.
moral_consequence: Frank loses weight and feels energized by additional vitamins.
immoral_action: Frank skips eating breakfast in order to shed some pounds.
immoral_consequence: Frank is tired and less focused at work.

norm: You're expected to go home for Christmas.
situation: Roy is going to have some extra time off this season for Christmas break, and he usually spends it going home to see his family.
intention: Roy wants to change up what he normally does during Christmas.
moral_action: Roy goes home for Christmas but arranges a new activity for the family to do.
moral_consequence: Roy's family starts up a new holiday tradition thanks to his idea.
immoral_action: Roy spends the holiday going on a trip with friends instead.
immoral_consequence: Roy's family doesn't get the same enjoyment out of Christmas without him.

norm: You should not use your workplace as your personal space.
situation: Alex works a lot of overtime at a game development company so is at his desk a lot.
intention: Alex wants to be able to catch up on his hobbies during his breaks.
moral_action: Alex uses his breaks to connect with others online and keep up to date on developments in his hobbies.
moral_consequence: Alex is able to organize his hobby time better, so he gets more done when he is home.
immoral_action: Alex paints minatures during his breaks and splashes paint all over his desk.
immoral_consequence: Alex is forced to cover the cost to repaint the desk.

norm: It's wrong to steal food from a store.
situation: Hank is a homeless man who's been sitting outside a gas station all day, asking people for money to eat all day with no luck.
intention: Hank wants a meal.
moral_action: Hank goes to a food bank up the road and asks for help in getting a meal.
moral_consequence: The food bank gives Hank enough food to last him a week, and he walks away satisfied.
immoral_action: Hank walks into the convenience store and sticks several candy bars in his pocket and walks out.
immoral_consequence: The manager calls the police and Hank is arrested for petty theft.

norm: It's frowned upon to be overly dramatic.
situation: Someone stole Tara's $5 bracelet, and she hasn't told anyone yet.
intention: Tara wants to tell her friends that her bracelet was stolen.
moral_action: Tara tells her friends that someone stole her bracelet, but she's glad that she can buy a new one.
moral_consequence: Tara's friends don't have to feel bad and don't have to feel scared.
immoral_action: Tara tells her friends that someone stole her super expensive bracelet with tears in her eyes.
immoral_consequence: Tara's friends feel bad for Tara and believe that she really liked the bracelet.

norm: It's good to arrive at an event early.
situation: Craig has a conference he needs to attend for work that is very important, and he can get to a number of ways.
intention: Craig wants to choose a route to go to the conference.
moral_action: Craig takes a route that is shorter.
moral_consequence: Craig arrives early and Craig's boss is pleased that he is responsible.
immoral_action: Craig takes a route that is longer.
immoral_consequence: Craig arrives late and Craig's boss at work reprimands him and develops less trust in Craig.

norm: It's nice to team up with others.
situation: Pat had a big exam coming up, and he knows his classmate Jeff is also having trouble.
intention: Pat wants to decide whether he should exchange notes with Jeff.
moral_action: Pat asks Jeff as they're walking out of class if he'd want to exchange notes with him.
moral_consequence: Pat does well on the exam and feels grateful for Jeff.
immoral_action: Pat would rather compete with Jeff to get a better grade, so he studies on his own.
immoral_consequence: Pat does poorly on the exam, and he regrets his decision.

norm: You shouldn't get in a romantic relationship with a student.
situation: Robin is a college professor with lots of interesting attractive students.
intention: Robin wants to find a romantic partner.
moral_action: Robin downloads a dating app and starts to look for a relationship online.
moral_consequence: Robin finds himself a partner, and they end up getting married.
immoral_action: Robin asks one of his students out on a date.
immoral_consequence: Robin gets fired from the university.

norm: It's hurtful to leave your family.
situation: Steve's mom yells at Steve far too much, and he is getting annoyed about it.
intention: Steve wants to do something about it.
moral_action: Steve confronts his mother about how she's been screaming at him too much.
moral_consequence: Steve's mother tells him she didn't know, and says she's going to work on it.
immoral_action: Steve decides to cut off his mother from his life.
immoral_consequence: Steve's mom didn't realize how she was treating Steve and is devastated she can't fix it.

norm: It is polite to cater to special needs guests.
situation: Dot wants to invite Skip, who has a number of food allergies, to  her party.
intention: Dot wants Skip to have a good time at the party.
moral_action: Dot asks Skip what foods he likes and can eat, and makes sure to serve at least one thing he's listed.
moral_consequence: Skip has fun chatting with friends and listening to music, and really enjoys the snacks Dot provides.
immoral_action: Dot doesn't make any attempt to accommodate Skip's allergies with special foods.
immoral_consequence: Skip has fun chatting with friends and listening to music, but leaves early because he's hungry.

norm: You should respect people's personal boundaries
situation: Tim was waiting in line for the restrooms at a concert.
intention: Tim wants to use the restroom as soon as possible.
moral_action: Tim waits his turn and uses the bathroom after his turn comes up.
moral_consequence: Tim gets to use the restroom and gets to see all of the concert.
immoral_action: Tim cuts in line and pushes his way through to a bathroom stall.
immoral_consequence: Tim gets accosted by angry concert goers and gets thrown out for fighting.

norm: It is hateful to consider short people subhuman.
situation: Dave is at a party when he's introduced to a very short man named James.
intention: Dave wants to say something to James.
moral_action: Dave tells James that he's glad to meet him and that he hopes to get to know him better.
moral_consequence: James is delighted to meet Dave and is happy that Dave wants to hang out more.
immoral_action: Dave tells James that he's so tiny he's hardly even a man and that Dave feels scared to shake his hand because he might hurt him.
immoral_consequence: James is infuriated that Dave is emasculating him and disrespecting him in front of everyone.

norm: It's bad to not take care of your teeth
situation: Brad is in the bathroom getting himself ready before going to bed.
intention: Brad wants to take care of his hygeine.
moral_action: Brad brushes his teeth before washing his face and hands and then going to bed.
moral_consequence: Brad's teeth are nice and clean and his mouth is germ free as he sleeps the night away.
immoral_action: Brad washes his hands and rinses his face and then turns off the light and goes to bed.
immoral_consequence: The bacteria in Brad's teeth continue to multiply leading to cavities and tooth decay.

norm: It's wrong to ignore a crime in progress.
situation: James was waiting for the bus when a mugger tried to snatch the purse from the lady standing behind him.
intention: James wants to avoid getting injured.
moral_action: James records the mugging on his phone and gives the recording to the police.
moral_consequence: The police immediately recognize the mugger as a frequent flyer in their jail cells and promptly arrest him at a nearby bar and return his victim's money.
immoral_action: James stares forward and pretends that he can't hear anything.
immoral_consequence: James has to listen to the victim sob about how her rent money was in her purse and now she'll get evicted.

norm: It is evil to lie and cheat on someone.
situation: Dave and Bill played the lotto together with an equal share and Dave has find out they've won $1000.
intention: Dave wants to tell Bill what amount they won.
moral_action: Dave tells Bill they won 1000 dollars and that Bill is going to get 500 dollars share.
moral_consequence: Bill later finds out Dave was telling the truth and is happy to continue partnering with Dave.
immoral_action: Dave tells Bill they won 400 dollars and that Bill is going to get 200 dollars share.
immoral_consequence: Bill later finds out Dave was lying and is angry and sad that Dave lied and stole from him.

norm: You should offer help if you see somebody needs it
situation: Jeff is walking home when he sees a frail homeless man begging for food.
intention: Jeff wants to give something to the homeless man.
moral_action: Jeff gives the homeless man some money and tells him to buy some food with it.
moral_consequence: The homeless man is grateful for Jeff's kindness and is able to feed himself for a week with the money Jeff gave him.
immoral_action: Jeff walks over to the homeless man and hands him a job application.
immoral_consequence: The man cries as a result of Jeff's action before going to bed hungry.

norm: It is disgusting to groom a child for sexual use.
situation: Logan has sexual urges but doesn't have a wife.
intention: Logan wants someone to expend his urges on.
moral_action: Logan searches for a spouse that matches his personality.
moral_consequence: Logan finds a spouse and has a fulfilling relationship, physically and mentally.
immoral_action: Logan gives gifts to a 14-year-old girl to win her favor.
immoral_consequence: The girls parents become scared and call the police on Logan.

norm: It is rude to ask personal questions for other people.
situation: Phil was at work talking to his coworkers Mike and Jane.
intention: Phil wants to stimulate conversation.
moral_action: Phil asks Mike and Jane what their favorite hobby is.
moral_consequence: Phil listens to Jane talk about football and Mike talk about all the TV show's he's seen.
immoral_action: Phil asks Mike and Jane what religion they happen to be.
immoral_consequence: Mike replies that's a personal question leaving Phil embarrassed.

norm: You shouldn't force someone to do something they don't want.
situation: Eleanor has a daughter.
intention: Eleanor wants her daughter to do an extracurricular activity.
moral_action: Eleanor asks her daughter what activity she wants to do and signs her up for that.
moral_consequence: Eleanor's daughter is able to do something that makes her happy.
immoral_action: Eleanor signs her daughter up for dance classes even though her daughter dislikes dance.
immoral_consequence: Eleanor's daughter is upset with Eleanor and does not participate fully during the classes.

norm: It's wrong to steal candy without paying for it.
situation: When Jack got to the gas station, he realized he forgot his wallet.
intention: Jack wants to eat a Hundred Grand in the next few minutes.
moral_action: Jack searched his car for change and found about two dollars' worth.
moral_consequence: Jack managed to purchase and savor his Hundred Grand candy bar.
immoral_action: Jack tries to slip a Hundred Grand bar down the front of his pants.
immoral_consequence: Jack wasn't caught, but the Hundred Grand was melted and gross from his body heat.

norm: You shouldn't wear revealing clothes at work.
situation: Diane has bought a new outfit at the mall that is quite revealing.
intention: Diane wants to show off her new outfit.
moral_action: Diane's takes a picture wearing the outfit and posts it on social media.
moral_consequence: Diane's coworkers are impressed by how beautiful she looks outside of work.
immoral_action: Diane decides to wear the new and revealing outfit to work.
immoral_consequence: Diane's coworkers struggle to take her seriously as a professional.

norm: You should not drink before driving a boat.
situation: Kevin and friends rent a boat to have a party on the lake.
intention: Kevin wants to drive the boat.
moral_action: Kevin drives the boat before drinking.
moral_consequence: Kevin has fun taking his friends around the lake.
immoral_action: Kevin has a few shots of vodka and then drives the boat.
immoral_consequence: Kevin goes too fast and beaches the boat on the shore.

norm: It's bad to assault others.
situation: Tommy and David are having an argument on their front lawn about where they can park their cars.
intention: Tommy wants to park where he wants.
moral_action: Tommy compromises with David and each take turns parking in the desired spot.
moral_consequence: The neighborhood respects Tommy and Tommy parks comfortably.
immoral_action: Tommy decides to punch David in the jaw, knocking him over in front of the neighborhood.
immoral_consequence: People in the neighborhood resent Tommy and he gets arrested.

norm: It's rude to use someone's sexuality as an insult.
situation: Linda and her homosexual coworker Phil are together in the office when they get an email that there's forced overtime on saturday.
intention: Linda wants to express her displeasure about the overtime to Phil.
moral_action: Linda tells Phil that the overtime is ridiculous, and she can't believe that they're forcing it on them.
moral_consequence: Phil is happy he's not the only one that feels that the forced overtime is a bad idea.
immoral_action: "Linda tells Phil ""this stupid overtime is so gay"" and frowns at him."
immoral_consequence: "Phil is insulted and embarrassed that Linda is equating the word ""gay"" with something horrible."

norm: It's indefensible to abuse your children.
situation: Phil's son Jason comes home with a report card full of bad grades.
intention: Phil wants to reprimand Jason for the bad grades.
moral_action: Phil tells Jason that it's not good enough to have such grades and that he has to do better and tries to guilt him.
moral_consequence: Jason begins to understand how his grades make his father feel and vows to do better.
immoral_action: Phil slaps the report card out of Jason's hand then proceeds to slap Jason around while berating him.
immoral_consequence: Jason is traumatized and terrified and is shocked his father is attacking him.

norm: It's bad to quit last minute and leave people hanging.
situation: George promised to help pull Fred's truck out of the ditch today, but then he won baseball tickets.
intention: George wants to go to the baseball game.
moral_action: "George tells Fred, ""How about we pull your truck out a few hours sooner, and we both go to the game?""."
moral_consequence: Fred and George pull the truck out together, and then they both go to the baseball game.
immoral_action: George goes to the baseball game instead, leaving Fred literally ditched.
immoral_consequence: Fred is furious at George for abandoning him like that.

norm: It's good to communicate your feelings with your roommate.
situation: Keara lives in a shared apartment with a roommate who is extremely messy.
intention: Keara wants her apartment space to be tidy.
moral_action: Keara talks to her roommate and points out how messy the place looks.
moral_consequence: Keara's roommate feels guilty about it and starts to clean up more often.
immoral_action: Keara decides to clean up the mess that her roommate has made herself.
immoral_consequence: Keara's roommate is encouraged to think his messiness is acceptable.

norm: You shouldn't bring weapons to school.
situation: Tyler just woke up and is getting ready to go to school at his house that is full of things.
intention: Tyler wants to impress his friends at school today.
moral_action: Tyler brings s skateboard with him to school and performs tricks on it for his friends.
moral_consequence: Many students see the tricks Tyler is doing and are greatly entertained and enjoy themselves.
immoral_action: Tyler puts a gun into his book bag because he thinks his friends will find it cool.
immoral_consequence: Many students are frightened to their cores when they see Tyler pull a gun out of his book bag thinking he is going to use it.

norm: It is polite to congratulate someone when they get married.
situation: Jessica and Andy just exchanged wedding vows and Jessica is telling her coworker Jane all about it.
intention: Jane wants to respond to Jessica.
moral_action: Jane listens to Jessica tell her story then tells her how happy she is for her and gives her a hug.
moral_consequence: Jessica feels good having a friend like Jane she can share happy moments with.
immoral_action: Jane listens to Jessica tell her story, but quickly changes the subject to celebrity weddings.
immoral_consequence: Jessica feels that Jane doesn't care and thinks she is rude.

norm: You shouldn't ignore your coworkers.
situation: Bob is at the office trying to get some work done but his coworker keeps asking him questions.
intention: Bob wants to not answer any more of his coworkers questions.
moral_action: Bob tells his coworker that he can't answer any questions because he has to do some work, so they leave him alone.
moral_consequence: Bob's coworker understands that they are being a distraction to Bob, and they try to respect work boundaries more.
immoral_action: Bob doesn't respond to his coworker's questions and just stares ahead and continues working as if he can't hear them.
immoral_consequence: Bob's coworker thinks Bob's behavior is strange and cold since he's not responding to them although he can clearly hear them.

norm: It's good to stay hygienic.
situation: Bobby has been sweating all day at work, but he is so tired that he doesn't feel like doing anything but going to bed.
intention: Bobby has to decide whether he wants to take a shower before bed.
moral_action: Bobby decides that it is worth his last bit of energy to clean himself up before going to bed.
moral_consequence: He emerges from his shower feeling fresh and clean, and he sleeps very comfortably for the whole night.
immoral_action: He decides that he's just too tired to take a shower tonight and slips into bed while he is still dirty and sweaty.
immoral_consequence: Bobby just can't get comfortable and sleep well, he doesn't feel clean and his skin is getting irritated by the bed linens against the dirt and sweat.

norm: It's frowned upon to drink alcohol in excess.
situation: Joe is at work function where there is an open bar.
intention: Joe wants to have a good time.
moral_action: Joe limits his alcohol consumption to a reasonable amount, so he is just buzzed enough.
moral_consequence: Joe has a good time and does not embarrass himself.
immoral_action: Joe drinks way too much and gets drunk.
immoral_consequence: Joe makes a fool of himself in front of his coworkers.

norm: It is deceitful to hide accruing debt from your husband.
situation: Tracy keeps buying things using Ted's credit card, but she's not keeping track of her expenses.
intention: Tracy wants to keep buying stuff with the card.
moral_action: Tracy lets Ted know that she is buying groceries with his credit card.
moral_consequence: Ted is able to come up with a plan to pay off the debt in a reasonable period of time.
immoral_action: Tracy buys a Peleton Bike and a Louis Vuitton handbag with Ted's credit card.
immoral_consequence: Ted eventually has to file for bankruptcy and sell some of their assets to debtors.

norm: You shouldn't have an abortion behind your partner's back.
situation: Vivian has just been impregnated by her partner who is firmly pro life, but they cannot support a child.
intention: Vivian wants to terminate the pregnancy.
moral_action: Vivian sits down with her partner and explains how they cannot provide for the child.
moral_consequence: Vivian's partner reluctantly leaves the final decision up to her to choose.
immoral_action: Vivian withholds the pregnancy from her partner and gets an abortion without him knowing.
immoral_consequence: Vivian's partner eventually finds out and is unable to forgive her actions.

norm: A good landlord takes care of rodent problems.
situation: Tiffany informs her landlord with financial issues Caden about the rats in the common room.
intention: Caden wants to save money.
moral_action: Caden makes a deal with an exterminator for discounted services.
moral_consequence: Tiffany and the exterminator hit it off, and go on a date after he cleans the common area.
immoral_action: Caden tells Tiffany that he will take care of the problem, but he doesn't do anything.
immoral_consequence: Tiffany's rat problems get worse.

norm: It's wrong to try to get someone fired.
situation: Arthur is officemates with Kyle, who talks incessantly and annoys Arthur.
intention: Arthur wants to get away from Kyle.
moral_action: Arthur gets a coworker who's rarely in the office to switch with him.
moral_consequence: Arthur has a much easier time getting his work done.
immoral_action: Arthur tells his boss that Kyle is skimming money from the company.
immoral_consequence: Arthur's boss investigates and fires Arthur when it's discovered he was lying.

norm: It's kind to buy a gift for another person.
situation: Dave is at Wendy's while his wife Susan is at home and Dave is ordering food when the hostess asks him what he wants.
intention: Dave wants to pick what food to order.
moral_action: Dave tells the hostess that he wants two hamburgers one which is for Susan.
moral_consequence: Susan is delighted to see that Dave brought her a gift of food home and that he was thinking about her.
immoral_action: Dave tells the hostess that he wants one hamburger which he'll take home to eat.
immoral_consequence: Susan is disappointed that Dave brought food home only for himself and nothing for her.

norm: You shouldn't throw rocks.
situation: Barry wants to practice pitching for the baseball team, but doesn't have a ball.
intention: Barry wants to improve his throw,.
moral_action: Barry ignores the stone and instead goes to a neighbor to ask to borrow a baseball.
moral_consequence: Barry practices his throw all afternoon and performs great at his next team practice.
immoral_action: Barry uses a stone as a baseball and when he throws it he pulls a muscle.
immoral_consequence: Barry can't play on the team with an injury.

norm: It's wrong to wallow in your own self pity.
situation: Jan made a big mistake at work is having trouble getting over it.
intention: Jan never wants to make the same mistake again.
moral_action: Jan doesn't think about the mistake anymore and is confident that it won't happen again.
moral_consequence: Jan never makes the same mistake again, and she is more productive at work.
immoral_action: Jan constantly thinks about what she did and intentionally makes herself feel bad.
immoral_consequence: Jan doesn't accomplish anything, and it just makes her feel worse.

norm: You should call the authorities if you witness a crime.
situation: Grant is watching a movie one night when a barking noise drowns out the sound.
intention: Grant wants speak to his neighbor about his loud dog.
moral_action: Grant witnesses an intruder entering the neighbor's side window after complaining about the barking, so he quickly calls 911 to report the burglary.
moral_consequence: The neighbor was not harmed and the officers safely apprehended the criminal before he could escape.
immoral_action: Grant sees a man breaking into the neighbor's house after talking to him, but doesn't call the police.
immoral_consequence: The neighbor is knocked unconscious and all of his valuables are stolen.

norm: It's okay to accept someone's invitation.
situation: Randy is working away in his office when he's interrupted by Paul who asks him if he'd like to go out for drinks after work.
intention: Randy wants to respond to Paul's invitation.
moral_action: Randy tells Paul that he'd love to come, he'll meet him in the lobby after work.
moral_consequence: Paul is delighted that he has a drinking partner for tonight and tells Randy he's looking forward to it.
immoral_action: Randy tells Paul that he doesn't want to go out and spend money, he'd rather just be home after work.
immoral_consequence: Paul is a little bit insulted that Randy has rebuffed him and thinks Randy must live a boring life.

norm: Taking money from someone's wallet would be wrong.
situation: Ken has a bill that needs to be paid and finds his brother Oliver's wallet lying around.
intention: Ken wants to pay the bill.
moral_action: Ken asks Oliver if he can loan him the money he needs.
moral_consequence: Oliver happily gives Ken the money to pay the bill.
immoral_action: Ken pulls money from the wallet without asking Oliver first.
immoral_consequence: Oliver finds out that Ken took his money without permission and gets mad.

norm: You shouldn't steal someone's credit card.
situation: Iris can't afford to pay her car insurance, and she sees her boyfriend's credit card on the table.
intention: Iris wants to pay her bill.
moral_action: Iris pulls aside her boyfriend and asks him to loan her some money.
moral_consequence: Iris is able to pay her bill.
immoral_action: Iris takes her boyfriend's credit card and uses it to pay her bill.
immoral_consequence: Iris loses her relationship with her boyfriend when he notices the charge on his account.

norm: It's disgusting to fail the needs of a child.
situation: Jordan was taking care of his younger brother for the day.
intention: Jordan wants to change the boy's diaper.
moral_action: Jordan make sure to change the boy's diaper as often as he can.
moral_consequence: The boy is happy and well taken care of when Jordan watches him.
immoral_action: Jordan waits all day to finally change his younger brother's diaper.
immoral_consequence: By the time that Jordan changes the child's diaper, he already has diaper rash.

norm: It's rude to call someone out on their rare mistakes.
situation: James is under a lot of stress because of tight deadlines when a coworker accidentally deletes a day's worth of work.
intention: James wants to vent his frustration.
moral_action: James takes a quick break and calls his wife from outside the building to complain about the coworker.
moral_consequence: James feels calmer after talking to his wife and can concentrate on recovering the files.
immoral_action: James yells at his coworker, calling him incompetent and a burden.
immoral_consequence: James' coworker holds a grudge and ignores James' requests whenever he can.

norm: It's expected that you share with your siblings.
situation: Eddie has bought a large chocolate bar.
intention: Eddie wants to enjoy most of the candy by himself.
moral_action: Eddie gives his little brother a small piece of the chocolate and acts like the bar is smaller than it is.
moral_consequence: Eddie's little brother is excited about the candy he's given.
immoral_action: Eddie hides the chocolate from his little brother and eats it all himself.
immoral_consequence: Eddie's little brother finds the empty wrapper and is upset that he didn't get any.

norm: It's disappointing to hear that you can't keep a dog.
situation: Rachel finds a dog in the street and bring it home to her father Daniel.
intention: Daniel wants to get the dog out of the house.
moral_action: Daniel tells Rachel that the dog need her help to get home.
moral_consequence: Rachel takes the dog through the neighborhood to find its owner.
immoral_action: Daniel tells Rachel that she can't have a dog.
immoral_consequence: Rachel starts crying.

norm: It's rude to hit other people.
situation: Joy is a seven year old who likes playing with her best friend, Layla.
intention: Joy wants to play Barbies with Layla.
moral_action: Joy waits patiently for Layla to finish playing with the doll she wants.
moral_consequence: Joy and Layla have a nice afternoon playing Barbies and do it again the following week.
immoral_action: Layla takes the Barbie that Joy wanted to play with, so Joy hits her in the face.
immoral_consequence: Layla begins to cry and her mom forbids her from playing with Joy ever again.

norm: You shouldn't lie to your family.
situation: May is struggling in school and her parents ask how her grades are.
intention: May wants to hide the truth about her grades.
moral_action: May finds a way to change the subject, so she doesn't have to lie.
moral_consequence: May's parents assume she's doing fine and don't ask again for awhile.
immoral_action: May tells her parents that she is doing well in school currently.
immoral_consequence: May's parents find out from the school that she did not tell the truth and ground her.

norm: It's not nice to gossip about your ex partners.
situation: Gabriel's boyfriend broke up with her, and she is out at the bar with her friends.
intention: Wants to appear as if the break up didn't hurt her.
moral_action: Gabriel spends the night dancing and telling jokes with her friends, and avoids bringing up her ex.
moral_consequence: Gabriel and her friends have a great night together and make lots of memories.
immoral_action: Gabriel tells her friends that it was her who broke up with her boyfriend, because he wasn’t smart or wealthy enough.
immoral_consequence: Her ex-boyfriend's brother overhears, and tells her friends that she is lying, causing her friends to distrust her.

norm: It is rude to be a bad house guest.
situation: Ronin house is undergoing renovations and is a guest at his friends place for the weekend.
intention: Ronin wants to have a lot of fun with his friend.
moral_action: Ronin buys a couple beers and drinks with his friend but cleans up after himself.
moral_consequence: Ronin's friend really enjoys his company and invites him to come back over sometime.
immoral_action: Ronin buys a bunch of alcohol, gets drunk with his friend and ends up blacking out and trashing the house.

norm: It's rude joke about serious matters

norm: You shouldn't interfere in a friend's relationship unless they ask.

norm: It's not okay to take something that isn't yours.

norm: You should not interfere with your partner's career.
situation: John is a married man who is excited because he just found out that he won a trip for two to Spain.

norm: It's bad to let your son down.

norm: It's bad to drink and drive.
situation: John is at at party and he is pretty drunk.

moral_consequence: John gets home quickly and safely.

norm: It's good to know a cure for depression.
situation: Bob has a friend that he thinks might be going through mental health issues due to his erratic behavior.

norm: It's rude to make too much noise around other people.

norm: Knowing when a relationship has become toxic is mature.
situation: Glenda's longtime boyfriend has started being abusive to her, but apologized later and told her he is very stressed at work.

norm: It's wrong to cheat in games.

norm: It's not okay to deceive people about who you are.

norm: You shouldn't give away someone else's pet.

immoral_consequence: Lina's ex boyfriend is devastated when he finds out his cat is gone.

norm: It's wrong to ignore your instructor.
situation: Mike is in history class.
