intention: Victor wants to buy the game.
moral_action: Victor sees the game on a trusted website for $300 and buys it there.
moral_consequence: Victor plays the game and has lots of fun with it.
immoral_action: Victor sees the game on a shady website for $11 and buys it there.
immoral_consequence: Victory later sees a video about stolen game keys and feels bad.

norm: You shouldn't make fun of your friends.
situation: Dave and Alfonso are in high school and have been friends for a few years.
intention: Dave wants to fit in with more of the neighborhood kids.
moral_action: Dave and Alfonso remain close with each other and stick together as they befriend other neighborhood kids.
moral_consequence: Some of the kids become close with both Dave and Alfonso, and they become a good group of friends.
immoral_action: Dave is nice to Alfonso when they are alone but picks on him when other kids are around.
immoral_consequence: The neighborhood kids befriend Alfonsi, but do not see Dave as loyal or trustworthy enough to be friends.

norm: It's good to care about your child's oral hygiene.
situation: Lydia notices that her son Maxwell forgot to brush his teeth just as it's time to leave for school.
intention: Lydia wants to drop Maxwell off at school.
moral_action: Lydia tells Maxwell to go brush his teeth before they leave.
moral_consequence: Maxwell has fresh breath and enjoys sitting with his friends before school.
immoral_action: Lydia tells him to just get in the car figuring one day with unbrushed teeth won't hurt.
immoral_consequence: The kids at school make fun of Maxwell for his smelly breath.

norm: It's wrong to interfere without permission in family members relationship.
situation: Mary just learned that her sister's husband is having an affair with a coworker, but her sister doesn't know about it.
intention: Mary wants to help her sister be happy.
moral_action: Mary asks her sister how her marriage is going and tells her she's always there for her.
moral_consequence: Mary's sister is happy to feel some support and asks Mary for advice, which she finds helpful and makes her feel stronger.
immoral_action: Mary tells her sister that her husband is having an affair.
immoral_consequence: Mary's sister is completely devastated by the news and doesn't know what she should do now.

norm: You should tell people before you leave somewhere.
situation: Kendra goes to the mall with her friend, and they are shopping at different stores.
intention: Kendra wants to leave the mall.
moral_action: Kendra finds her friend and tells her she's leaving before heading home.
moral_consequence: Kendra's friend keeps shopping at the mall in a carefree manner.
immoral_action: Kendra leaves the mall without saying anything to her friend and goes home.
immoral_consequence: Kendra's friend spends time looking around for Kendra and starts to worry about where Kendra is.

norm: You shouldn't post racist things online.
situation: Ken is reading a story on a news website about Black Lives Matter who he thinks are taking the wrong approach.
intention: Ken wants to post a comment showing his disagreement with BLM.
moral_action: Ken writes a long narrative explaining why he thinks BLM is a good idea with a flawed approach and uses respected sources to back his claims.
moral_consequence: The people who read Ken's message respect Ken's point of view as they see Ken as a civilized person, whether they agree with him or not.
immoral_action: Ken writes a long narrative full of slurs and hateful messages against black people going on to state he hates BLM and all black people in general.
immoral_consequence: The people who read Ken's message are horrified and saddened that such hate exists in this world.

norm: It's wrong to trespass on other people's property.
situation: Josh was playing baseball with his friends when the ball went into his neighbor's back yard.
intention: Josh wants the ball back.
moral_action: Josh knocks on his neighbor's door and asks him if he can get his ball.
moral_consequence: Josh's neighbor goes to the backyard and gets the ball for Josh himself.
immoral_action: Josh climbs over the fence and sneaks into his neighbor's yard to get the ball.
immoral_consequence: Josh's neighbor sees him in the yard and calls the cops to report him for trespassing.

norm: It's rude not to tip your server at a restaurant.
situation: Sebastian just finished eating breakfast at a local diner and is getting ready to leave.
intention: Sebastian wants to say thank you to the waiter.
moral_action: After paying for his meal, Sebastian slips the server 15 dollars and says he is grateful for the service.
moral_consequence: The server is pleased because this has been his best tip today.
immoral_action: Sebastian pays for the meal only, and tells the waiter that he appreciates the service.
immoral_consequence: The server is disappointed, because simply being appreciated isn't going to pay the bills.

norm: You shouldn't slap people with things.
situation: Mark is reading the newspaper while Maria screams and cries at a television show.
intention: Mark wants to make Maria stop crying.
moral_action: Mark hugs Maria and offers some interesting behind the scenes facts about the show.
moral_consequence: Marie feels like Mark understands truly understands her which improves their relationship.
immoral_action: Mark wacks Maria with his newspaper to disrupt her thoughts.
immoral_consequence: Maria gets mad at Mark for treating her badly.

norm: It's bad to leave kittens on their own.
situation: Mark's cat just had kittens, and they're meowing all the time.
intention: Mark wants to get rid of the kittens.
moral_action: Mark talks to a friend who loves cats, and she agrees to take the kittens and care for them.
moral_consequence: The kittens are safe and happy.
immoral_action: Mark puts the kittens in a box and leaves them in an alley.
immoral_consequence: The kittens die of exposure.

norm: It's wrong to send nudes to friends.
situation: Camden has a crush on his best friend Savanna.
intention: Camden wants to get Savanna's attention.
moral_action: Camden hands Savanna a love poem the next time he sees her.
moral_consequence: Savanna asks Camden out on a date.
immoral_action: Camden sends Savanna a picture of himself laying in the bed naked.
immoral_consequence: Savanna ends her friendship with Camden.

norm: You shouldn't lose contact with someone you love.
situation: John and his girlfriend has a long distance relationship.
intention: John wants to manage his communications with his girlfriend.
moral_action: John maintains steady contact with his girlfriend until they meet again in person.
moral_consequence: John has a fulfilling relationship with his girlfriend.
immoral_action: John starts to call his girlfriend less and misses the calls from his girlfriend.
immoral_consequence: John's girlfriend breaks up with John.

norm: You shouldn't stare at someone's butt.
situation: Dustin is at work and is in the break room with a diverse group of fellow employees.
intention: Dustin wants to zone out.
moral_action: Dustin gets out his mobile phone and starts to play some games on it to pass the time without thinking too much.
moral_consequence: Dustin enjoys his time on break and returns to work ready to be productive.
immoral_action: Dustin notices an employee he finds attractive standing near the coffee maker, and he stares at their backside as he gets lost in thought.
immoral_consequence: Another employee notices Dustin's ogling and makes a complaint against him to human resources.

norm: It's wrong to give people false hope.
situation: Penny is the judge for an art contest her friend has entered and her friend keeps asking about what the judges are planning to do.
intention: Penny wants to spare her friend's feelings because she does not believe her friend's art is good enough.
moral_action: Penny lets her friend know that others have submitted very good entries and the judges will probably pick one of them.
moral_consequence: Penny's friend is a little disappointed but understands.
immoral_action: Penny dodges her friend's questions and gives vague answers about how she thinks her friend still has a good chance.
immoral_consequence: Penny's friend gets her hopes up and ends up very disappointed when she doesn't win.

norm: It's irresponsible to leave your work.
situation: Paul is working as a tow truck driver when he gets a text from his wife saying that their son has been suspended at school.
intention: Paul wants someone to go talk to the principal to find out why his son is suspended.
moral_action: Paul texts his wife and asks her to go to the school and talk to the principal about their son's suspension.
moral_consequence: Paul tows six cars on his shift and even gets tipped by one of his customers.
immoral_action: Paul drives over to the school and goes in to see the principal personally.
immoral_consequence: Paul misses a number of job calls for his tow truck and gets reprimanded by his boss.

norm: It's kind to adopt a puppy that needs a home.
situation: Yuri notices a dog running around outside that appears to be a stray.
intention: Yuri wants to help the dog.
moral_action: Yuri coaxes the dog into her home and keeps him as a pet.
moral_consequence: The dog lives a healthier life indoors with Yuri.
immoral_action: Yuri leaves some food and water outside where she saw the dog.
immoral_consequence: The dog continues to suffer living on the streets.

norm: It's wrong to hate every picture your friend posts.
situation: Jenny is looking at her friend Renee's Instagram feed and thinks the pictures aren't that good.
intention: Jenny wants to talk to Renee about her pictures.
moral_action: Jenny tells Renee that her pictures could be better and gives her tips.
moral_consequence: Renee will improve the quality of her pictures.
immoral_action: Jenny tells Renee that her pictures are terrible.
immoral_consequence: Renee will feel insulted and not want to talk to Jenny.

norm: It's rude to be annoying to someone.
situation: Charles is a boy in school.
intention: Charles wants to share his solution to the math problem.
moral_action: Charles asks another student if they want to share math problem solutions with each other.
moral_consequence: The other student will want to have Charles as a math partner.
immoral_action: Charles tells another student how his math problem solution is always right, and they're probably wrong.
immoral_consequence: The other student won't want to interact with Charles in the future.

norm: You shouldn't eat things that aren't meant to be eaten.
situation: Samuel is hiking along a mountain trail when he suddenly feels hungry.
intention: He wants to eat something.
moral_action: Samuel reaches into his backpack and pulls out some trail mix to eat.
moral_consequence: Samuel satisfies his hunger with the trail mix and continues on his hike.
immoral_action: Samuel picks some berries from a nearby tree to eat even though he doesn't know anything about them.
immoral_consequence: Samuel gets a terrible stomachache and is sick for three days when it turns out the berries are poisonous.

norm: It's good to comfort your crying child.
situation: Mimi is watching a movie with her young son, Benji, when a monster comes on screen and Benji begins to cry.
intention: Mimi wants to not hear Benji's crying.
moral_action: Mimi consoles Benji and explains to him that monsters aren't real.
moral_consequence: Benji learns about the reality of monsters and stops crying.
immoral_action: Mimi walks out of the room and leaves Benji to cry alone.
immoral_consequence: Benji continues to cry and grows a fear towards monsters.

norm: It's careless to not pay attention while driving.
situation: Adam is driving on the highway when he receives a text from his boss.
intention: Adam wants to respond to his boss.
moral_action: Adam presses a button on his Bluetooth headset calling his boss.
moral_consequence: Adam and his boss grow closer talking about their jobs before work.
immoral_action: Adam glances at his phone sending a text while driving.
immoral_consequence: Adam gets into a car accident.

norm: You shouldn't disturb your siblings.
situation: Ally just got home from school and sees her brother is trying to get his homework done, so he can play with his friends.
intention: Ally wants to share a long, but funny, video with her brother.
moral_action: Ally walks past her brother and sets a reminder to show him the video later.
moral_consequence: Ally's brother finishes his work in time to hang out with his friends and enjoys the video when he watches it later that night.
immoral_action: Ally pushes her brother's homework out of the way and forces him to watch the video.
immoral_consequence: Ally's brother gets distracted and doesn't finish his work in time to play with his friends.

norm: It's encouraged to lose fat if you're overweight.
situation: When Jenna went in for her yearly medical checkup, her doctor said she had gained thirty pounds.
intention: Jenna wants to feel good about her body.
moral_action: Jenna starts exercising three times a week and stops drinking soda and juice.
moral_consequence: The next time Jenna sees her doctor, she's proud of her ten pound weight loss.
immoral_action: Jenna finds a new doctor who doesn't confront her about her weight.
immoral_consequence: Jenna gains another twenty pounds over the next year and begins to develop sleep apnea.

norm: It's mean to enjoy giving bad news.
situation: Steve had to tell his co-worker that he was fired.
intention: Steve wants to get rid of the guy quick.
moral_action: Steve, with a frown on his face, informs the coworker he is fired.
moral_consequence: The coworker is thankful for Steve's consideration and leaves his job peacefully.
immoral_action: Steve tells the coworker that he is fired with a big smile on his face.
immoral_consequence: Steve's coworker thinks Steve is joking, and comes to work the next day, only to get fired again.

norm: It's wrong to declaw cats.
situation: Jenny just adopted two cats and sees that they are scratching her loveseat and sofa.
intention: Jenny wants to protect her new furniture.
moral_action: Jenny buys a scratching post for her cats and trains them to stay off the sofa.
moral_consequence: Jenny's cats are happier and can defend themselves too.
immoral_action: Jenny takes her cats to the vet and has them declawed.
immoral_consequence: Jenny's cats become depressed and can't defend themselves from other animals.

norm: It's nice to stay persistent.
situation: Ashley has gained weight after a long vacation with her family.
intention: Ashley wants to lose weight.
moral_action: Ashley joins a health club and insists on doing workout everyday even though it is tough.
moral_consequence: Ashley loses 5 pounds in a month, and she feels very satisfied.
immoral_action: Ashley takes diet pills which she thinks is easy and effortless.
immoral_consequence: Ashley has serious diarrhea, and she needs to be treated by a doctor.

norm: It's rude to make assumptions based on skin color.
situation: Kristen's brother recently started dating an Asian girl named Kelly.
intention: Kristen wants to get to know Kelly.
moral_action: Kristen asks Kelly where she works and what her hobbies are.
moral_consequence: Kristen and Kelly get to know each other and become friends.
immoral_action: Kristen asks Kelly if she works for a nail salon since she is Asian.
immoral_consequence: Kelly is offended by Kristen's question and walks away.

norm: It's good to help people when they are depressed.
situation: Jeff approached a friend who recently lost his mother in a car accident and is depressed about it.
intention: Jeff wants to consider talking to his friend.
moral_action: Jeff talks to his friend and does his best to console him.
moral_consequence: Jeff's friend thanks Jeff and becomes a little less depressed.
immoral_action: Jeff decides against talking to his friend and completely ignores him.
immoral_consequence: Jeff begins to get viewed as an uncaring person by his friend.

norm: You should give friends space when they need it.
situation: Adrian's friend Steve is going through a rough time in his relationship with his girlfriend and looks gloomy and depressed.
intention: Adrian wants Steve to feel better.
moral_action: Adrian asks Steve how he's doing and offers to chat if he wants to, then leaves him alone.
moral_consequence: Steve recovers a bit and wants a friend to confide in, so he contacts Adrian to talk with him.
immoral_action: Adrian sits with Steve and asks him what is wrong, continuing to ask him when he evades Adrian's questions.
immoral_consequence: Steve withdraws even more and refuses to be around Adrian because it hurts too much to answer.

norm: It's good to own up to your past mistakes.
situation: Bill is at work talking with his boss who is giving him a performance review.
intention: Bill wants to look good in front of his boss.
moral_action: Bill's boss asks about a mistake Bill made during the last year and Bill uses the opportunity to explain what he learned from making that mistake to his boss.
moral_consequence: Bill's boss is impressed that Bill owned up to the mistake turning it into a positive learning experience and gives Bill a good review.
immoral_action: Bill's boss asks Bill about a mistake he made and as to look better, Bill blamed others for the event.
immoral_consequence: Bill's boss is disappointed that Bill is not honest with him and is forced to give Bill a bad performance review.

norm: It's good to appreciate something a friend owns.
situation: Calvin has his friend Bill over at his house and shows him the new car he bought and asks Bill what he thinks of it.
intention: Bill wants to reply to Calvin's question.
moral_action: Bill tells Calvin that it's a really fine automobile and that Bill wishes he had one like it.
moral_consequence: Calvin is delighted that his friend likes his car and that he confirmed his decision to buy it.
immoral_action: Bill tells Calvin that it's kind of ugly for how much it cost him and it was probably a dumb purchase.
immoral_consequence: Calvin is insulted that Bill thinks he made a bad decision and is insecure about having bought the car.

norm: It's bad to do things to others that are wrong.
situation: Ted is playing a game with some random people online against a computer opponent.
intention: Ted wants to challenge himself.
moral_action: Ted handicaps himself by not using the most powerful techniques, then still manages to emerge victorious.
moral_consequence: Ted's allies are impressed by Ted's skills and learn some new techniques from his playing style.
immoral_action: Ted helps defeat the computer opponent, then turns against each of his allies and backstabs all of them.
immoral_consequence: Ted's allies feel betrayed and outraged, then embarrassed as Ted defeats each of them.

norm: It's rude to be late for class.
situation: Penelope is in college and her chemistry class starts in five minutes.
intention: Penelope wants to get some extra sleep.
moral_action: Penelope runs to chemistry class on time and goes back to sleep after class is over.
moral_consequence: The chemistry instructor is happy and so are all the students.
immoral_action: Penelope sleeps thirty more minutes and stumbles into chemistry class late.
immoral_consequence: The chemistry instructor is angry and some students lose their train of thought.

norm: You shouldn't look under someone's skirt.
situation: Jeff is in a college class with Mary and sits across from her.
intention: Jeff wants to keep himself busy in class.
moral_action: Jeff sits somewhere else to avoid distraction and focuses on taking good notes during the lecture.
moral_consequence: Jeff is able to do well in the class and has no negative incidents.
immoral_action: Jeff peeks up Mary's skirt throughout the class when he thinks no one sees.
immoral_consequence: Mary's notices Jeff doing this and files a complaint for harassment cause humiliation for Jeff.

norm: It's bad to chicken out at the last minute.
situation: Amanda is supposed to go to her doctor's appointment to get the results of a test.
intention: Amanda wants to decide if she will enter the building.
moral_action: Amanda heads right in to see her doctor and find out the results.
moral_consequence: It turns out the test result is negative thus she isn't sick at all.
immoral_action: Amanda runs away at the last minute because she's afraid of the possible news.
immoral_consequence: Now it takes her much longer to find out, and she panics for much longer.

norm: It is rude to make someone cry.
situation: John is at home with his wife Mindy on a Friday night.
intention: John has low self esteem and wants to feel better about himself.
moral_action: John asks Mindy if she wants to volunteer with him at the shelter.
moral_consequence: John feels better about himself and Mindy is happier.
immoral_action: John yells at and verbally degrades Mindy all night while pumping himself up.
immoral_consequence: Mindy cries alone and John's good feelings are short-lived.

norm: You shouldn't let your kids say bad things about you.
situation: Peter's toddler, Bella, has been throwing lots of tantrums and saying hurtful things.
intention: Peter wants Bella to feel loved.
moral_action: "Peter makes Bella eat broccoli, and when she calls him ""stupid"" in response, Peter tells her that her behavior is inappropriate."
moral_consequence: Bella learns not to say things like that, and learns healthy eating habits on top of it.
immoral_action: Bella tells Peter he's stupid after he makes her eat broccoli, and all he does is apologize out of fear of her feeling unloved.
immoral_consequence: Bella's behavior continues on the same path, and she never learns how to be respectful or eat healthy.

norm: It's rude to push people when unprovoked.
situation: Amy was late for work and there was a long line in front of her waiting to get on the train including an old handicapped woman.
intention: Amy wants to get to work on time.
moral_action: Amy notices a shorter line at another train door and runs there to catch the train.
moral_consequence: The old woman is able to get on the train and get to her doctor's appointment on time.
immoral_action: Amy pushes the old woman in front of her out of the way so that she can get the last spot on the train.
immoral_consequence: The old woman misses her doctor's appointment when the train takes off without her.

norm: It's nice to have visitors.
situation: Tim visits his grandmother at the nursing home on a weekly basis, where he often notices a man who is always alone.
intention: Tim wants to know more about the lonely man.
moral_action: Tim walks up to the lonely man and asks him how his day is going.
moral_consequence: The man tells Tim that it is nice to have someone to talk to, and they become great friends over time.
immoral_action: Tim asks the nursing home staff about the lonely man.
immoral_consequence: The lonely man sees Tim and the staff looking at him and pointing, and retreats to his room feeling picked on.

norm: It's expected that you'll attend a family member's funeral.
situation: Joe's father died and the funeral is set to take place in the morning.
intention: Joe wants to remember his father.
moral_action: Joe goes to the funeral with his mother and other family members.
moral_consequence: Joe finds moral support through being with his family through a hard time.
immoral_action: Joe sits at home looking at old photographs during the funeral service.
immoral_consequence: Joe's mom doesn't talk to him for a week because he missed the funeral.

norm: One should not be ashamed of their sexual desires.
situation: Billy starts to realize as he reaches puberty that he is more attracted to boys than girls.
intention: Billy wants to express his sexuality.
moral_action: Billy decides that he needs to be open with everyone about who he is, and he doesn't keep his sexuality a secret from anyone.
moral_consequence: Billy feels open and proud of who he is, even when the conversation is difficult for him to have he prefers to be open about his sexuality.
immoral_action: Billy is careful to only be open to people who he knows will be accepting of his sexual preferences, because he is embarrassed.
immoral_consequence: Billy feels ashamed of himself because he is keeping a secret from most of the people he knows.

norm: It's wrong not to vaccinate yourself.
situation: Greg is planning an upcoming trip to a remote area in a third world country.
intention: Greg wants to protect himself on the trip.
moral_action: Greg receives a full compliment of vaccines before traveling to the foreign country.
moral_consequence: Greg has a good trip and remains healthy throughout.
immoral_action: Greg buys a knife and a bullet proof vest prior to his trip.
immoral_consequence: Greg gets a vaccine preventable illness on his trip and suffers from health issues caused by it.

norm: You should respect your partner if they are genderfluid.
situation: Leon's significant other, Pat, has recently come out to Leon as being genderfluid.
intention: Leon wants to talk to Pat about their identity.
moral_action: Leon asks Pat about their preferred pronouns and if he can help them in any way.
moral_consequence: Pat feels supported and their bond with Leon becomes stronger.
immoral_action: Leon laughs at Pat, telling them that being genderfluid isn't real and refuses to use Pat's correct pronouns.
immoral_consequence: Pat is hurt and saddened by Leon's actions and the couple breaks up.

norm: It's wrong to haze someone in college
situation: Frank is in charge of his fraternity and has to decide how to initiate the incoming freshmen.
intention: Frank wants to pick an event that the new class will remember.
moral_action: Frank decides to throw a party welcoming all the freshmen.
moral_consequence: The freshman class feels accepted in their new group.
immoral_action: Frank decides to haze the new brothers by making them act like servants for the older brothers.
immoral_consequence: The new initiates resent their fraternity brothers.

norm: It's important to agree on big things with your partner.
situation: Paul and Robert are looking for a school to enroll their 5 year daughter in.
intention: Robert wants to send his daughter to a school he feels comfortable with.
moral_action: Robert tells Paul about a school he found, and they end up enrolling their daughter there after they visit the school together.
moral_consequence: Paul feels confident in the decision and is excited about the first day of school.
immoral_action: While Paul was at work, Robert went to an open house for a school with limited openings and signed their daughter up.
immoral_consequence: Paul feels hurt that he wasn't consulted and feels uncomfortable about their daughter starting school.

norm: You should be respectful of others at work.
situation: It's lunch time in the open floor plan office where James works in close quarter with others.
intention: James wants to eat lunch at his desk while he finishes a project.
moral_action: James goes out and gets a salad to eat while he finishes working.
moral_consequence: James and his co-workers are all able to get their work done without much disruption.
immoral_action: James goes out and gets curry from an Indian takeout for lunch.
immoral_consequence: Jame's co-workers are annoyed by his strong-smelling food and disrupted from their work.

norm: It is not good to talk bad about a gift
situation: Susan has just received a shiny gold jacket from her friend Lou for her birthday and Lou asks her what she thinks of it.
intention: Susan wants to answer Lou's question.
moral_action: Susan tells Lou that it's a gorgeous one of a kind jacket and that she'll love wearing it.
moral_consequence: Lou is delighted that Susan loves her gift and that she said she'd be glad to go out wearing it.
immoral_action: Susan tells Lou that the jacket is gaudy and hideous, and she wonders why he'd think she would like it.
immoral_consequence: Lou is insulted that Susan not only hates his generous gift but that she's insinuating that he has no taste or style.

norm: It is mean to not attend a family event.
situation: Timothy's family is having a family reunion today, and he is not sure if he wants to go.
intention: Timothy wants to avoid being bored all day.
moral_action: Timothy goes to the reunion and does his best to engage his family in interesting conversations.
moral_consequence: Timothy has a lot of fun and ends up going out for drinks afterwards with his cousins having a great time.
immoral_action: Timothy decides to go to an amusement park instead of the family reunion.
immoral_consequence: Timothy's family finds out and ostracizes him from the family.

norm: You shouldn't block people with your carts in the supermarket.
situation: Joe was in the supermarket looking for a can of corn in the aisle.
intention: Joe wants to walk across the aisle to the canned goods.
moral_action: Joe pulls his cart as far to the side as he can while looking for the canned goods.
moral_consequence: The other customers are able to move past Joe while he is searching.
immoral_action: Joe leaves his shopping cart in the middle of the aisle while he looks for the canned goods.
immoral_consequence: The other customers aren't able to get around Joe's cart because he left it in the middle of the aisle.

norm: It is rude to make faces at someone.
situation: Steve was upset with Pascal because he was rude to him earlier.
intention: Steve wants revenge on Pascal.
moral_action: Steve decides to annoy Pascal by telling jokes about him.
moral_consequence: Steve manages to annoy Pascal for a while but Pascal eventually finds the jokes funny.
immoral_action: Steve decides to make faces at Pascal to annoy him.
immoral_consequence: Steve manages to annoy Pascal with his faces which in turn make Pascal want revenge on him...

norm: It's wrong to leave religious pamphlets out as tips.
situation: Minny is an avid churchgoer who is eager to spread the gospel, and is also regularly served at a diner by Jen.
intention: Minny wants Jen to receive a religious pamphlet.
moral_action: Minny finishes her meal and leaves a 20 percent tip along with a religious pamphlet.
moral_consequence: Jen is grateful and reads the pamphlet, then agrees to go to church with Minny when Minny is there again.
immoral_action: When Minny finishes her meal, she leaves only a religious pamphlet with a note that this is her tip.
immoral_consequence: Jen throws the pamphlet away in anger and Is very cold to Minny the next time.

norm: It is rude to not arrive on time.
situation: Mary needs a job and her friend got her an interview at her place of work.
intention: Mary wants to go to the interview.
moral_action: Mary gets to the job interview early in order to make a good impression.
moral_consequence: The interviewer is impressed by Mary's punctuality and gives Mary the job on the spot.
immoral_action: Mary gets to the interview over twenty minutes later than it was scheduled.
immoral_consequence: The interviewer dismisses Mary, and she doesn't get the job that she wanted.

norm: It's deplorable to sleep with a member of your family.
situation: Steve has a stepsister Sally who he always found attractive, and they're both out drinking together and the bar is closing.
intention: Steve wants to continue having a good time with Sally.
moral_action: Steve and Sally walk to a nearby diner and have a long, rambling and entertaining conversation over a late night meal.
moral_consequence: The next morning, the two of them have a good time talking about what they did the previous night.
immoral_action: Steve and Sally go home and collapse drunkenly into eachother's arms in bed.
immoral_consequence: When they wake up next morning, they're both horrified at what they've done.

norm: It's bad to mistreat your child.
situation: Dave is at home when he's called by his neighbor who says Dave's son Max has been stealing tools from his garage.
intention: Dave wants to reprimand his son Max.
moral_action: Dave tells his son Max that he is grounded, and he needs to return all the tools right away.
moral_consequence: Max learns right from wrong and realizes that he has made a major mistake and apologizes.
immoral_action: Dave tells his son Max to get in the basement and locks him down there for two days without food or water.

norm: You should discuss disagreements calmly.

norm: It's rude to complain constantly about your health concerns.

norm: You shouldn't make fun of customers in your store.

norm: Playing a prank on a roommate can be mean.

norm: It's good to practice at something so you get better.

norm: It's important to go to school.

norm: It's wrong to keep a secret from your significant other.

norm: You shouldn't rummage through other's belongings.

norm: Roommates should respect each other's rules and boundaries.

norm: You shouldn't violate professional ethics at your job.

norm: You shouldn't steal from your boss.

norm: It's wrong not to clean your fingernails because it's gross.

norm: You shouldn't get people wet.

norm: You shouldn't hate your sister.

norm: It's not okay to spy on others.
