moral_action: Timmy says okay and gets his grandmother what she wanted from the other room before starting to watch TV.
moral_consequence: Timmy's grandmother thinks Timmy is a helpful and polite boy, and she smiles at him.
immoral_action: Timmy goes to the TV and starts watching a show as if he didn't hear his grandmother's request at all.
immoral_consequence: Timmy's grandmother thinks that he is incredibly rude for not responding to her when she needs help.

norm: You shouldn't call online dating gross.
situation: Molly is at a bar with her coworkers when they start discussing their dating lives.
intention: Molly wants to impress her coworkers by appearing very hard to date.
moral_action: Molly says that she gets lots of attention in everyday life and won't try online dating because she doesn't need to.
moral_consequence: A coworker who found their partner through online dating sees Molly's point and continues speaking with her.
immoral_action: Molly remarks that online dating is a gross and unnecessary way to find a date because she gets plenty of attention in her daily life.
immoral_consequence: A coworker who found their partner through online dating is offended and walks away in digust.

norm: It is good to take care of your children.
situation: Carl was at home with his two kids when he got called out to go to work.
intention: Carl wants to go to work.
moral_action: Carl calls a babysitter to watch the kids while he is at work.
moral_consequence: Carl's kids are safe with the babysitter while he is at work.
immoral_action: Carl leaves his children at home alone while he goes to work.
immoral_consequence: One of Carl's children falls and hurts themselves without an adult around.

norm: You shouldn't judge the entire group of people
situation: John comes home from work upset that Mr. Goldstein overcharged him for his car service at the shop.
intention: John wants to vent his anger.
moral_action: John tells his family that he's upset how much the bill was and will probably go elsewhere next time.
moral_consequence: John's family consoles John and develops normally without any racist views.
immoral_action: John tells his family in a raised voice that all Jews are like that.
immoral_consequence: John's family respects John less and possibly develop anti-semitic views themselves.

norm: It is kind to help your neighbors.
situation: Joe is relaxing on his patio, and he sees that his neighbor, Ryan, is having trouble starting his lawnmower.
intention: Joe wants to react to the situation.
moral_action: Joe offers his help to start Ryan's lawnmower and is able to get it running.
moral_consequence: Ryan thanks Joe for his help and begins mowing his lawn.
immoral_action: Joe tells Ryan that it looks like he's not going to be able to mow his lawn today since his lawnmower won't start.
immoral_consequence: Ryan frowns and tells Joe that he's not being very helpful.

norm: You shouldn't stay with someone who cheats on you.
situation: Brad is having a conversation with his spouse because he just caught her cheating on him.
intention: Brad wants to resolve the issue.
moral_action: Brad is open and honest with his spouse and lets her know the relationship is over because of her transgression.
moral_consequence: Brad saves himself further heart ache by ending the relationship and enjoys some alone time.
immoral_action: Brad is convinced by his spouse's justification for her behaviour and decides to stay with her.
immoral_consequence: Brad has his heart broken further when his spouse cheats on him again not long after their conversation.

norm: You shouldn't dump your problems on other people.
situation: Leah is dealing with a toxic relationship with a guy her friend doesn't like and is having problems deciding what to do.
intention: Leah wants to get some advice on her issue.
moral_action: Leah goes on the internet to find discussions and articles of similar problems to draw from.
moral_consequence: Leah's friend notices her pulling away from the guy and is glad she is taking initiative.
immoral_action: Leah approaches her friend about the situation sparing no details.
immoral_consequence: Leah's friend is bothered by having spend time dealing with her problems.

norm: It's good to deliver on promises that you make.
situation: Ian told his son Danial that they would go on a vacation to the beach, but Ian's salary got cut.
intention: Ian wants to have fun with his son.
moral_action: Ian contacts a vacation rental property, and he is able to pay the rent fee in low monthly installment payments.
moral_consequence: Danial has fun exploring the beach with his dad.
immoral_action: Ian takes his son to a free overnight camping event on a playground.
immoral_consequence: Danial spends the trip in a bad mood because he didn't want to go camping.

norm: It is rude to make someone feel uncomfortable in public.
situation: Mae wants to avoid talking about politics with her best friend at the mall.
intention: Mae wants to distract her friend.
moral_action: Mae points out something in the nearby interesting in the nearby store/.
moral_consequence: Mae's friend walks into the store, and they end up buying something they need for work.
immoral_action: Mae asks her best friend about her sex life.
immoral_consequence: Mae's friend feels humiliated and exposed in front of a crowd.

norm: You should try to help your friends whenever you can.
situation: Sally is leaving work a bit early to do some shopping on her way home when she sees her friend is having trouble getting his work finished.
intention: Sally wants to get some essentials she needs for her home.
moral_action: Sally offers to help her friend as she can order her groceries online and pick them up a bit later.
moral_consequence: Sally's friend gets his work done with Sally's help and the boss is very pleased.
immoral_action: Sally walks past her friend and figures he will find a way to get his work done.
immoral_consequence: Sally's friend does not get his work finished that day, and he gets in a lot of trouble at work.

norm: It's wrong to date others when you're already dating someone.
situation: Ryan is dating a girl but has lost his feelings for her when he meets a new girl that peaks his interest.
intention: Ryan wants to date the new girl.
moral_action: Ryan breaks up with his current girlfriend before dating the new girl.
moral_consequence: The new girl appreciates having a new man in her life.
immoral_action: Ryan starts going out with the new girl while he's still in a relationship.
immoral_consequence: The new girl finds out and no longer wishes to see him.

norm: You shouldn't act upon urges that you know are bad.
situation: Tony hasn't had fulfilling sex in a very long time and is feeling stronger and stronger urges.
intention: Tony wants to have a healthy sex life.
moral_action: Tony works on improving himself and starts looking for a girlfriend.
moral_consequence: Tony find a girlfriend, and they end up having a very healthy active sex life.
immoral_action: Tony makes an arrangement with a sex worker.
immoral_consequence: Tony has sex with the sex worker and catches an STD.

norm: You shouldn't play loud noise if it disturbs your neighbors.
situation: Cindy, who has elderly neighbors, loves music and just got a new set of speakers for her house.
intention: Cindy wants to play her favorite song on the speakers.
moral_action: Cindy plays the song at medium volume and shuts the windows.
moral_consequence: Cindy enjoys the song and her neighbors enjoy peace and quiet.
immoral_action: Cindy plays the song and turns it up to test the capabilities of the speakers.
immoral_consequence: The neighbors can't think straight and get very annoyed and angry at Cindy.

norm: It's good to do nice things for love interests.
situation: Barry is dating Tonya and her birthday is tomorrow.
intention: Barry wants to save his money.
moral_action: Barry spends what he can afford on a nice gift for Tonya and saves the rest.
moral_consequence: Tonya loves the gift and is happy and feels closer to Barry.
immoral_action: Barry pretends he forgot Tonya's birthday date and doesn't get her anything.
immoral_consequence: Tonya feels sad and wonders whether Barry is right for her.

norm: It's good to listen to the advice of your mentors.
situation: Pat just graduated high school, and his mentor was telling him to make sure he gets a degree.
intention: Pat wants to say something to his mentor.
moral_action: Pat tells his mentor that he's definitely going to get his degree.
moral_consequence: Pat puts himself in a better position to get a good paying job.
immoral_action: Pat tells his mentor that he doesn't need a degree since he's already smart.
immoral_consequence: Pat has trouble getting jobs due to being too arrogant.

norm: It's good for siblings to share things with each other.
situation: John is eating cookies in the kitchen when his brother, Tom, walks in and asks if he can have some.
intention: John wants to respond to Tom.
moral_action: John tells Tom that he would be happy to give him some cookies, and they eat the rest of the cookies together in the kitchen.
moral_consequence: Tom feels grateful to his brother and glad that he was able to enjoy the cookies.
immoral_action: John tells Tom to find his own cookies and John eats the rest by himself.
immoral_consequence: Tom feels upset by his brother's selfishness.

norm: It's wrong to cheat on a test in school.
situation: Rob is taking his final exams.
intention: Rob wants to get a high score.
moral_action: Rob stays up all night studying extra hard for the exams.
moral_consequence: Rob is treated to his favorite meal when his parents see his high test score.
immoral_action: Rob hides his study notes in his sleeve and uses them to ace the exam.
immoral_consequence: Rob is flunked when the instructor finds out about him cheating.

norm: It is good to engage with people.
situation: Josh comes home tired from work, and he feels the need for companionship.
intention: Josh wants to do something relaxing.
moral_action: Josh invites his friends over to his house for a movie night.
moral_consequence: Josh gains a new perspective on his work when his friend express their concerns during the movie.
immoral_action: Josh spends the evening playing solitaire on the computer.
immoral_consequence: Josh goes to bed lonely.

norm: You should eat if you're hungry.
situation: Alyssa struggles with her appearance.
intention: Alyssa wants to lose weight.
moral_action: Alyssa decides to eat healthy and cut out junk food.
moral_consequence: Alyssa loses weight while remaining happy and healthy.
immoral_action: Even though she feels hunger, Alyssa decides to starve herself in the hopes of losing weight.
immoral_consequence: Alyssa becomes severely malnourished and ends up in the hospital.

norm: It's not okay to let drugs ruin your relationships.
situation: Mike is a pot user and has a hard time holding a job, making him poor, and his parents are urging him to quit for his own good.
intention: Mike wants to decide between his parents or pot.
moral_action: Mike decides to make efforts to quit and asks his parents for help to do so.
moral_consequence: Mike's parents are very happy and send Mike to rehab, which successfully breaks his addiction.
immoral_action: Mike decides to keep using pot and starts selling his parents’ belongings to support his addiction.
immoral_consequence: Mike's parents give up on him and kick him out, putting him on the street with no home.

norm: You shouldn't try to get your partner jealous.
situation: Carrie thinks Doug isn't paying enough attention to her.
intention: Carrie wants Doug to focus more on her.
moral_action: Carrie asks Doug why he isn't paying as much attention to her lately.
moral_consequence: Doug points out it was really busy at work but that busy time will end soon.
immoral_action: Carrie flirts with Dave to try to make Doug jealous of him.
immoral_consequence: Doug thinks Carrie is cheating on him with Dave, so he punches Dave.

norm: It's wrong to openly carry weapons in public.
situation: Zeke is at the big box store where he has just purchased a huge revolver.
intention: Zeke wants to take the revolver out of the store.
moral_action: Zeke puts the revolver in his backpack before going out of the store into the parking lot.
moral_consequence: The people in the parking lot have no idea Zeke is armed and go about their business as normal.
immoral_action: Zeke keeps the revolver in his hand as he exits the store into the parking lot.
immoral_consequence: The people in the parking lot scatter as they think that Zeke might be attempting to kill someone.

norm: Nudity is frowned upon.
situation: Brad is sitting at home naked just relaxing, when his doorbell suddenly rings.
intention: Brad wants to respond to the doorbell ringing.
moral_action: Brad tells the people at the door that they need to wait a minute before he can come answer, so he can get dressed.
moral_consequence: The people at the door wait patiently while Brad is off getting dressed.
immoral_action: Brad goes to his front door and opens it to see who's ringing the doorbell.
immoral_consequence: The people at his door are shocked and disgusted by unexpectedly seeing Brad standing naked before them.

norm: It's bad to break up with someone over something trivial.
situation: Chloe is eating a meal with her partner who is chewing loudly despite Chloe having told him she does not like that.
intention: Chloe wants to stop hearing her partner eat loudly.
moral_action: Chloe communicates clearly with her partner about how she would appreciate it if he would work on his habit of chewing loudly.
moral_consequence: Chloe feels cared about when her partner makes an effort to curb the volume of his chewing.
immoral_action: Chloe informs her partner that she has had enough of his loud chewing and that she is leaving him.
immoral_consequence: Chloe finds herself alone and without a partner again and again because of behavior like this.

norm: It's frustrating to be given ultimatums by your roommate.
situation: Brian and Rex and roommates in a small dorm room and Rex is always leaving his things lying around.
intention: Brian wants to get Rex to clean up his side of the room.
moral_action: Brian chats with Rex, mentioning that he would prefer a cleaner room and checks to see if Rex has any complaints about him that he can work on.
moral_consequence: Rex feels like Brian is being respectful towards him, and he decides to be helpful, so they can strengthen their relationship.
immoral_action: Brian tells Rex that he will file a complaint with the Resident Assistant to get him kicked out if he doesn't clean up his things immediately.
immoral_consequence: Rex picks up his things but decides that he doesn't like Brian, and he plans to move out as soon as possible.

norm: It's expected to have good communication with ones spouse
situation: David 's friends are going to the bar but his wife is going to stay home.
intention: David wants to go to the bar with his friends.
moral_action: David goes to the bar and keeps his phone on so that his wife can contact him.
moral_consequence: David's wife is pleased that she can call and talk to him while he's out.
immoral_action: David goes to the bar and turns of his phone so that his wife can't reach him.
immoral_consequence: David's wife is angry at David for not allowing her to call him.

norm: It's wrong to not take responsibility for your own actions.
situation: Danny crashed his car into Doug's when pulling into his driveway.
intention: Danny wants to decide how to deal with the damage.
moral_action: Danny tells Doug right away that he hit Doug's car.
moral_consequence: Doug is fine with it and just asks Danny to fix the car.
immoral_action: Danny pulls his car back and when Doug notices the damage Danny simply insists it wasn't him.
immoral_consequence: Doug doesn't know who it was, so he becomes aggravated at everyone.

norm: It's rude to insult your partner's skills in the bedroom.
situation: Jasmine lays on her bed after  sex, and her boyfriend is playing video games instead of providing aftercare.
intention: Jasmine wants to get her boyfriend's attention.
moral_action: Jasmine sits in her boyfriend's lap and kisses him before asking for his attention.
moral_consequence: Jasmine's boyfriend feels like Jasmine really cares about him.
immoral_action: Jasmine tosses a pillow at him and says his skills in the bedroom were like a drunk man.
immoral_consequence: Jasmine's boyfriend feels bad about his performance.

norm: You shouldn't spill water on your friend's things.
situation: Jessica leaves the kitchen with a glass of water after an argument with her roommate.
intention: Jessica wants to vent her frusterations.
moral_action: Jessica rants about her feelings to another one of her friends.
moral_consequence: Jessica gets good advice on how to handle conflicts in the future from her friend.
immoral_action: Jessica pours the water onto roommates computer.
immoral_consequence: Jessica has to pay for a new computer for her roommate.

norm: It's hurtful to deprive a person of their property.
situation: Lance is a security guard at a sports venue and as he's frisking Todd at the entrance he finds a Swiss Army Knife that Todd's mom gave him.
intention: Lance wants to do something about the knife.
moral_action: Lance tells Todd weapons are prohibited, but he'll keep it with him and Todd can come back after the game and get it back.
moral_consequence: Todd is delighted that Lance found a good solution and promises to be back right at game's end at the same gate.
immoral_action: Lance tells Todd weapons are prohibited, and he has to confiscate the knife and throw it away.
immoral_consequence: Todd is devastated because the knife has sentimental meaning and it saddens him beyond belief to lose it.

norm: It is good not to play favorites
situation: Tina runs a small deli and recently hired two of her sons to add to the staff.
intention: Tina wants to promote someone to supervisor.
moral_action: Tina promotes the worker with the most experience to the position of supervisor.
moral_consequence: The store's profits remain steady and the new supervisor teaches Tina's sons a lot about the business.
immoral_action: Tina promotes her son, despite knowing that he doesn't have very much experience in running a shop.
immoral_consequence: Tina's son manages the store poorly and sales decrease as a result of his ineptitude as a supervisor.

norm: It is foolish to burn down your own house.
situation: Tony is sitting in his living room when he realizes it is a bit cold.
intention: Tony wants to make the room warmer.
moral_action: Tony gets up and adjusts the temperature on the thermostat on his heater.
moral_consequence: The heater kicks on and starts to warm up Tony's house.
immoral_action: Tony starts a fire in the living room of his house.
immoral_consequence: The house burns down and Tony is taken to the police station for questioning.

norm: You shouldn't sneak into places you aren't allowed.
situation: John hears about a new hit movie that was just released, but he's too young to buy rated R tickets.
intention: John wants to see the movie.
moral_action: John decides to watch the movie later when it's released on DVD, and sees a different film instead.
moral_consequence: John enjoys the movie on DVD from the comfort of home.
immoral_action: John buys tickets to a different movie and then sneaks into the rated R one.
immoral_consequence: John is caught by a theater employee towards the end of the movie and is kicked out.

norm: It is bad to murder others.
situation: Tom's grandfather is very weathly and has recently added Tom to his will.
intention: Tom wants to be rich.
moral_action: Tom asks his wealthy grandfather for business advice and a modest start up investment while at a family dinner party.
moral_consequence: Tom's business is reasonably successful, and he earns a steady income over the next several years.
immoral_action: Tom poisons his wealthy grandfather at a dinner party in order to inherit his share of his grandfather's fortune.
immoral_consequence: Tom's act is discovered by the police and convicted of murder, causing him to go to jail for the rest of his life.

norm: It's bad to smoke in a non-smoking room.
situation: Abraham has been on a plane for the last eight hours and is just stepping into the airport after his flight.
intention: Abraham wants to smoke a cigarette.
moral_action: Abraham waits for a few minutes until he is outside and then lights up a cigarette.
moral_consequence: The people in the non smoking area feel fine and are not bothered by Abraham's cigarette smoke.
immoral_action: Abraham lights up a cigarette immediately after stepping off the plane, right in the middle of a non-smoking area.
immoral_consequence: Some of the people sitting in the non-smoking area start to feel nauseous because of Abraham's cigarette smoke.

norm: It's wrong to blame an animal for someone abusing it.
situation: Bill is walking down the street with his friend when they see a man beating a dog with a stick.
intention: Bill wants to say something about seeing the man beat the dog.
moral_action: Bill says to the man that's beating the dog with a stick that what they are doing is not acceptable.
moral_consequence: Bill's friend is proud of Bill for standing up for the humane treatment of animals.
immoral_action: Bill says to his friend that the dog probably deserves to be beaten with a stick for misbehaving.
immoral_consequence: Bill's friend thinks Bill is heartless and doesn't care about the moral treatment of animals.

norm: It's polite to offer your services to others.
situation: Kerry is driving home and sees his friend Lisa walking on the side of the road.
intention: Kerry wants to get home.
moral_action: Kerry pulls up beside Lisa and offers her a ride.
moral_consequence: Lisa gets in the car and thanks Kerry for the ride.
immoral_action: Kerry passes by Lisa without giving a thought to offering her a ride.
immoral_consequence: Lisa gets mad at Kerry for passing by her without saying anything.

norm: It's wrong to deceive a customer.
situation: Jack is a salesperson and there are large incentives given for selling customers add-ons with products.
intention: Jack wants to earn a large bonus to purchase a gift.
moral_action: Jack provides a great reason explaining the value of the add-ons to the customer up front.
moral_consequence: The customer actually wants the add-on and Jack gets a bonus.
immoral_action: Jack opts the customer into buying add-ons and the customer signs without realizing it.
immoral_consequence: The customer later notices this and complains to the store about Jack.

norm: You shouldn't disrespect other's cultures.
situation: Kate invited her Asian neighbors to her house for a barbecue, and they took their shoes off inside.
intention: Kate wants to get them to put their shoes on.
moral_action: Kate tells the couple that they don't have to take their shoes off in her house.
moral_consequence: The couple feel more relaxed and feel welcomed in Kate's house.
immoral_action: Kate tells the couple to put their shoes on to get their germs off her floor.
immoral_consequence: The couple feels disrespected and doesn't feel welcomed in the house.

norm: It's wrong to ignore your partner.
situation: Toby his watching a big football game he recorded when his wife asks him a question.
intention: Toby wants to finish watching the game.
moral_action: Toby pauses the game to answer his wife before returning to watching it.
moral_consequence: Toby's wife is happy that Toby took some time to address her question.
immoral_action: Toby pretends that he didn't hear his wife and keeps watching the game.
immoral_consequence: Toby's wife feels insulted as she's sure that Toby heard her.

norm: It's wrong to call your teachers names.
situation: Bob is sitting in his math class.
intention: Bob wants to get his teacher's attention.
moral_action: Bob raises his hand and waits to speak until the teacher notices him.
moral_consequence: Bob has his question answered by the teacher.
immoral_action: Bob yells an expletive about the teacher's race very loudly.
immoral_consequence: Bob is suspended from school for a month.

norm: It's good to protect your neighborhood from harm.
situation: Larry lives on a lake in Florida and a hurricane is predicted to hit his neighborhood in two days.
intention: Larry wants to keep himself safe.
moral_action: Larry gets together with his neighbors and uses sandbags and storm shutters to help protect the neighborhood from flooding and high winds.
moral_consequence: Larry's neighborhood survives the storm with minimal damage and everyone is safe.
immoral_action: Larry decides to leave town and drives to stay with relatives who live far away from the hurricane's path.
immoral_consequence: Larry's neighborhood floods after the hurricane and everyone's homes are ruined.

norm: You shouldn't let yourself be taken advantage of by coworkers.
situation: Roxanne's teammates want to go out to happy hour and asked Roxanne if she can finish up their work for the day.
intention: Roxanne wants to make sure all the work gets done by the deadline.
moral_action: Roxanne tells her coworkers that if she does all the work, her coworkers won't know what's going on and won't be prepared to present their project.
moral_consequence: Her coworkers understand her point and stay to help finish up the work.
immoral_action: Roxanne agrees to take over her coworkers' work for the rest of the day.
immoral_consequence: Roxanne's coworkers go to the bar, but they get equal credit and bonuses after they present their project.

norm: It's good to be nice to friends of your children.
situation: Margaret and her friend Alexandria are having brunch and wine while their children play together nearby.
intention: Margaret wants to approach Alexandria about a dispute they were having.
moral_action: Margaret asks Alexandria if they could have a moment alone and discusses her dispute issues in private.
moral_consequence: Margaret and Alexandria work through their issues together in a productive manner and return to watching the children.
immoral_action: Margaret becomes intoxicated and loudly announces her issues with Alexandria.
immoral_consequence: The children become confused and distressed seeing Margaret in her agitated state, prompting Alexandria to ask her to get a ride home.

norm: You shouldn't keep your self harm a secret.
situation: Jackie's mom just died and Jackie has been cutting herself from depression.
intention: Jackie wants to be self-reliant.
moral_action: Jackie calls an ambulance for help on her own and pays for therapy too.
moral_consequence: Jackie recovers and lives a happier life.
immoral_action: Jackie cuts herself to pieces alone in her room.
immoral_consequence: The cops find Jackie dead the next morning.

norm: You shouldn't expect your parents to always babysit your kids.
situation: Steve, a single parent whose mom lives nearby, has a child and needs to go on a business trip for a few weeks.
intention: Steve wants someone to babysit the children.
moral_action: Steve talks with his mom and offers to give her money for a babysitter if she needs to do something.
moral_consequence: Steve's mom watches his child and hires someone for when she can't be around.
immoral_action: Steve drops off his child at his mom's house and sends her a text detailing the situation.
immoral_consequence: Steve's mom had important plans and is upset that she needs to take care of a child instead.

norm: It is good to provide a safe environment for children
situation: Tracy saved up enough money to build a pool for family and friends to enjoy.
intention: Tracy wants to stay within her pool budget.
moral_action: Tracy child proofs the pool while spending less on fancier materials to stay under budget.
moral_consequence: All of Tracy's family and friends have a great time at Tracy's pool.
immoral_action: Tracy passes on child proofing the pool to stick with budget.
immoral_consequence: Family and friends with kids don't enjoy Tracy's pool.

norm: Not helping an injured kid makes you look cowardly.
situation: Kyle is walking down the street when he sees Johnny, a kid, fall off his bike and hurt himself.
intention: Kyle wants to react to what he just saw.
moral_action: Kyle runs towards Johnny and tries to help him to make sure he's OK.
moral_consequence: The other pedestrians notice Kyle and are delighted he sprung to action to help Johnny.
immoral_action: Kyle turns and walks in the other direction lest he have to actually do something for the kid.
immoral_consequence: The other pedestrians notice Kyle and are disgusted by his running away from the situation.

norm: It's good to make time for others.
situation: Tom has a busy week at work but his daughter asks if they can spend some time together during the week.
intention: Tom wants to tell his daughter if he can spend time with her during the week.
moral_action: Tom says that he'll cancel some of his meetings to spend time with his daughter that week.
moral_consequence: Tom's daughter feels like Tom wants to spend time with her even when it's difficult to find the time for it.
immoral_action: Tom tells his daughter that he can't spend time with her that week because he's just too busy at work.
immoral_consequence: Tom's daughter feels like he cares more about his job than he does about her.

norm: You shouldn't humiliate your professors.
situation: Bruce is taking a nuclear physics class at Harvard University.
intention: Bruce wants to correct his professor's mistake during a class about gamma radiation.
moral_action: Bruce asks the professor a clarifying question, giving the professor a chance to catch his mistake.
moral_consequence: The professor thanks Bruce after the lecture for noticing the mistake, and the two become friends.
immoral_action: Bruce interrupts the lecture to tell the rest of the class that the professor made a simple mistake that anyone should have noticed.
immoral_consequence: The professor gets upset and gives Bruce a bad grade on the next exam.

norm: Helping others carry things is polite.
situation: Johnny comes back from shopping with his mother and there are many bags in the car to bring in the house.
intention: Johnny wants to play video games.
moral_action: Johnny helps his mother bring the bags in the house before starting to play video games.
moral_consequence: Johnny's mother is really helped by him carrying some of the bags and appreciates his effort.
immoral_action: Johnny runs in the house and starts playing video games leaving his mother to carry all the bags.
immoral_consequence: Johnny's mother has to work hard to carry all the heavy bags from the car.

norm: It's good to care about the happiness of others.
situation: Jack looks at the results for his business this year, and they made big profits.
intention: Jack wants to decide what to do with the profits.
moral_action: Jack gives all of his employees a big raise to keep the employees happy.
moral_consequence: Jack's employees are thrilled at getting a big raise.
immoral_action: Jack puts all the profits into more marketing and more advertisements.
immoral_consequence: Jacks employees are upset that none of the upturn went to them.

norm: It's good to give things to a friend.
situation: Dave is going through some old things in his garage that he never uses when he finds an old pair of hockey skates in perfect condition.
intention: Dave wants to be rid of the hockey skates.
moral_action: Dave calls his friend who's a hockey player and offers to have him pick up the skates for free.
moral_consequence: Dave's hockey player friend is delighted at the idea and is ecstatic to get some new skates for free.
immoral_action: Dave takes the hockey skates and throws them in the garbage since he has no use for them.
immoral_consequence: Dave's hockey player friend has to spend his own money buying new skates, stressing him out.

norm: You shouldn't hide bodies places.
situation: Anna owns a morgue and there has been a surplus of bodies lately.
intention: Anna wants to keep up with the surplus.
moral_action: Anna petitions the city's medical office for more resources and hires additional employees to keep up with the volume of bodies coming in.
moral_consequence: Anna's morgue is able to keep up with the bodies, and she is relieved.
immoral_action: Anna starts to bury bodies throughout the woods behind the morgue property that were supposed to be cremated in hopes to save time and resources.
immoral_consequence: Anna's illegal tactics for disposing of the bodies are discovered by the police, and she is put in jail.

norm: It's expected you be patient with family members
situation: Tina has a daughter Rita who is just learning to tie her shoes, and they are about to leave for the store.
intention: Tina wants Rita to tie her shoes.
moral_action: Tina waits for Rita to get the hang of tying her shoes before they leave.
moral_consequence: Rita gets her shoes tied and is a little more adept at it for next time.
immoral_action: Tina tries to hurry Rita up and make her go faster.
immoral_consequence: Rita keeps messing up the tying and having to restart, making the process take even longer.

norm: It's mean to tell someone you can't stand them.
situation: When Marty asked Liz to go to the dance with him, Liz was taken aback because she didn't even like Marty.
intention: Liz wants to turn down Marty's invitation to the dance.
moral_action: Liz tells Marty that she already has a date but that she's flattered he asked her.
moral_consequence: Marty is a little crestfallen, but he snaps out of it very quickly.
immoral_action: Liz tells Marty that she can't stand him and that she won't go to the dance with him.
immoral_consequence: Marty's confidence is crushed, and he never asks out another girl ever again.

norm: It's good to be responsible when it comes to school.
situation: Jenny has an important homework assignment due tomorrow for a class she's been struggling with.
intention: Jenny wants to spend time with her friends.
moral_action: Jenny spends an hour socializing with her friends then does her homework assignment.
moral_consequence: Jenny gets a decent grade on her homework and starts to understand the class material a bit better.
immoral_action: Jenny spends all night with her friends and doesn't even start her homework assignment.
immoral_consequence: Jenny gets a failing grade on her homework assignment and continues to have a hard time in the class.

norm: You shouldn't steal your parent's money.
situation: Carols daughter Jessica has been wanting an expensive purse, but is low on funds.
intention: Jessica wants to get the bag.
moral_action: Jessica tells Carol how badly she wants the purse, so Carol sympathizes and orders it for her.
moral_consequence: Jessica is thrilled to have what she wanted and Carol feels good making her happy.

norm: It's good to treat the disabled as equals.

norm: You shouldn't force someone to have an abortion.

norm: It's bad to trash a shared living space.

norm: It's rude to take advantage of a friend.

norm: It's good to help your friends move.

norm: It is greedy to marry just for money.

norm: It's not okay to drink yourself to excess.

norm: It is greedy to ask your friends for money.
